Authors: Xiayan Xu, Jiyu Yu, Xingzhou Chen, Siyi Qian, Zongyu Ma, Lilu Liu, Ling Shi, Haodong Zhang

Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization for Constrained Locomotion Planning Locomotion

constrained locomotion planning model-based diffusion generative optimization quadruped humanoid

简要说明：本文提出了2GO，一种基于模型且几何感知的生成优化方法，用于四足和人形机器人的约束运动规划，通过主动约束几何引导去噪并采用自适应扩散/流调度，提高了成功率和减少了违规。

TLDR: This paper introduces 2GO, a model-based geometry-aware generative optimization method for constrained locomotion planning in quadrupeds and humanoids, which uses active constraint geometry to shape denoising and an adaptive diffusion/flow-like schedule to improve success rates and reduce violations.

Abstract: Constrained Locomotion Planning (CLP) for quadrupeds and humanoids, where robots must satisfy collision avoidance, contact consistency, kinematic feasibility, and support constraints, is challenging under high-dimensional dynamics and highly non-convex environments. Recent Model-Based Diffusion (MBD) approaches recast trajectory optimization as posterior sampling over trajectories, using known dynamics and Monte Carlo rollouts to analytically estimate the denoising score function without demonstration learning. While constrained variants further incorporate feasibility into model-based score rollouts and show promising performance, they are still limited by (1) lacking a task-modulated active constraint geometry that shapes the score direction and reverse stochasticity, and (2) using deterministic DDPM-style reverse transport without adaptive scheduling across different generative transports. Therefore, we introduce Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization (2GO) for constrained locomotion, which turns active constraint geometry into executable denoising operators through normal- induced metric shaping, tangent-space stochastic filtering, and CFS-based retraction. 2GO further decouples generative transport from reverse stochasticity through an adaptive diffusion and flow-like schedule. Experiments on constrained quadruped and humanoid locomotion demonstrate strong performance in discrete foothold selection and continuous posture planning, with higher success rates, fewer violations, and improved execution compatibility.

摘要（中文）：约束式运动规划（CLP）针对四足机器人与仿人机器人，要求机器人在高维动力学与高度非凸环境中满足碰撞避免、接触一致性、运动学可行性及支撑约束，这一问题极具挑战性。近年来，基于模型的扩散（MBD）方法将轨迹优化重构为轨迹上的后验采样问题，利用已知动力学和蒙特卡洛 rollout，在不依赖示范学习的情况下解析估计去噪得分函数。尽管带约束的变体进一步将可行性纳入基于模型的得分 rollout 中，并展现出良好的性能，但仍存在两方面的局限：（1）缺乏任务调制的主动约束几何结构来塑造得分方向与反向随机性；（2）采用确定性 DDPM 式反向传输，未在不同生成传输之间进行自适应调度。为此，我们提出基于模型的几何感知生成优化（2GO）方法用于约束式运动规划，通过法向诱导度量整形、切空间随机滤波以及基于 CFS 的收缩操作，将主动约束几何结构转化为可执行去噪算子。2GO 进一步通过自适应扩散与类流调度，将生成传输与反向随机性解耦。在约束四足与仿人运动上的实验表明，该方法在离散落脚点选择与连续姿态规划中均表现出强劲性能，具有更高的成功率、更少的违规次数以及更好的执行兼容性。

Authors: Zhilin He, Xinyuan Wang, Changliu Liu

StairVLA: Stage-Aware Hierarchical Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action diffusion action head hierarchical action generation inference efficiency manipulation

简要说明：StairVLA 提出了一种面向 VLA 模型的分阶段层次化动作生成框架，利用部分去噪动作作为接口，将粗粒度长时程动作生成与高频局部细化解耦，在降低推理开销的同时在仿真和真实机器人任务上提升了成功率。

TLDR: StairVLA introduces a stage-aware hierarchical action generation framework for VLA models, using partially denoised actions as an interface to decouple coarse long-horizon generation from frequent local refinement, reducing inference cost while improving success rates on simulation and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on diffusion- or flow-matching-based action heads to generate continuous robot actions. These action heads typically process the denoising trajectory in a largely uniform manner. However, we observe that the conditioning focus naturally shifts across denoising stages: early stages combine language instructions and visual observations to establish a coarse action trajectory, whereas later stages place greater emphasis on current visual observations for action alignment. Based on this insight, we introduce StairVLA, a stage-aware hierarchical action generation framework that uses partially denoised actions as a natural interface between coarse long-horizon action generation and local refinement. A high-level VLA performs early denoising to produce a reusable long-horizon partially denoised action trajectory, while a lightweight refiner operates at a higher frequency to refine local action chunks using the latest observations. This design amortizes expensive high-level VLA computation while preserving frequent closed-loop correction. On LIBERO, our GR00T-style instantiation improves average success from 96.5% to 97.8% while reducing amortized inference latency from 115.0 ms to 44.2 ms per action chunk. More broadly, across two VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-robot tasks, StairVLA consistently reduces inference cost while maintaining strong task performance.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益依赖基于扩散或流匹配的动作头来生成连续的机器人动作。这类动作头通常以近乎统一的方式处理去噪轨迹。然而，我们观察到，条件关注的焦点在不同去噪阶段自然发生转移：早期阶段结合语言指令和视觉观察以建立粗略的动作轨迹，而后期阶段则更侧重于当前视觉观察以进行动作对齐。基于这一发现，我们提出了StairVLA，一种阶段感知的分层动作生成框架，利用部分去噪后的动作作为粗粒度长时程动作生成与局部细化之间的自然接口。高层VLA执行早期去噪，生成可复用的长时程部分去噪动作轨迹，而轻量级细化器则以更高频率运行，利用最新观测对局部动作块进行细化。该设计分摊了昂贵的高层VLA计算成本，同时保持了频繁的闭环修正能力。在LIBERO基准上，我们的GR00T风格实例将平均成功率从96.5%提升至97.8%，同时将每个动作块的摊销推理延迟从115.0毫秒降低至44.2毫秒。更广泛地，在两种VLA主干网络、仿真基准以及真实机器人任务中，StairVLA在保持强劲任务性能的同时，始终降低了推理成本。

Authors: Shangyuan Yuan, Xinda Qi, Yujiang Pu, Wenliang Guo, Xiaobo Tan

CoRE: Learning Collaboration-Role Experts for Decentralized Collaborative Manipulation with One Policy Manipulation

decentralized collaboration collaborative manipulation single-policy cross-attention experts action-expert alignment

简要说明：CoRE 提出了一种使用单策略进行去中心化协作操作的方法，通过查询条件的交叉注意力专家和融合的外观-几何特征，并利用动作-专家对齐损失在无需角色标签的情况下监督角色选择。该方法在仿真基准测试中达到了最高平均性能，并在物理实验中展示了跨多样操作任务的鲁棒性。

TLDR: CoRE introduces a single-policy decentralized collaborative manipulation approach using query-conditioned cross-attention experts and fused appearance-geometry features, trained with an action-expert alignment loss to supervise role selection without labels. The method achieves state-of-the-art simulation performance and demonstrates physical-world robustness across diverse manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Collaborative manipulation requires robots to perform complementary actions as interactions unfold. We study single-policy decentralized collaboration: every robot runs the same policy from its visual observations and proprioception, without task prompts, identity labels, or inter-robot messages. The challenge is to learn complementary team behaviors within shared parameters and select appropriate actions from each robot's local observations. We introduce CoRE, which learns Collaboration-Role Experts from pooled multi-task, multi-robot demonstrations. Fused appearance and geometry provide local interaction evidence. Query-conditioned cross-attention experts provide adaptable prediction paths, which a local router combines at each action-chunk position. During training, an action-expert alignment loss supervises expert selection using relative forced-route prediction errors against demonstrations under fixed inputs, without role labels. Across simulation benchmarks, CoRE achieves the highest average performance among evaluated decentralized methods. Physical experiments demonstrate effective collaboration across diverse manipulation tasks and robustness to partner delays and slowdowns. Project page: https://aus.bot/research/core/.

摘要（中文）：协同操作要求机器人在交互过程中执行互补的动作。本文研究单策略去中心化协作问题：每个机器人运行相同的策略，仅依靠自身视觉观测和本体感觉，无需任务提示、身份标签或机器人间通信。挑战在于如何在共享参数内学习互补的团队行为，并根据每个机器人的局部观测选择合适的动作。我们提出CoRE方法，从多任务、多机器人的混合演示中学习协作角色专家（Collaboration-Role Experts）。融合的外观与几何信息提供局部交互证据。查询条件的交叉注意力专家提供自适应的预测路径，由本地路由器在每个动作块位置进行组合。在训练过程中，动作-专家对齐损失利用固定输入下与演示相比的相对强制路径预测误差来监督专家选择，无需角色标签。在仿真基准测试中，CoRE在所评估的去中心化方法中取得了最高的平均性能。物理实验验证了该方法在多种操作任务中的有效协作能力，以及对伙伴延迟和减速的鲁棒性。项目主页：https://aus.bot/research/core/。

Authors: Yanan Zhou, Zhaoyan Qian, Zihao Li, Mingyuan Ba, Ranpeng Qiu, Weiming Zhi

Seeing Through the Displaced Frame: Privileged Noise Distillation for Vision-Force Precision Assembly Manipulation

privileged distillation vision-force assembly pose noise behavior cloning DAgger

简要说明：本文提出了一种特权的噪声蒸馏方法，用于视觉-力觉精密装配，教师模型在仿真或重标记演示中观察潜在框架偏移，使学生策略在FORGE基准和真实Franka机器人上实现高成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a privileged noise distillation method for vision-force precision assembly, where a teacher observes the latent frame offset in simulation or via relabeled demonstrations, enabling a student policy to achieve high success under pose noise on the FORGE benchmark and real Franka robot.

Abstract: Pose error in precision assembly can corrupt not only what a robot observes but also the coordinate frame in which it acts. On the FORGE benchmark, the official state-based policy succeeds in 97% to 99% of episodes with the true pose but only 32% to 60% at the benchmark's $σ=5$ mm pose-noise setting. The same estimated pose enters the observation and anchors the action frame, making the offset unidentifiable from proprioceptive state alone before contact. We supply this missing information during training in two ways. A privileged teacher observes the offset in simulation, while clean demonstrations can instead be relabelled into the displaced frame in closed form. The deployed student is trained with behaviour cloning followed by one DAgger round and receives only noisy state, a raw wrench window, and two RGB cameras at test time. On the unmodified FORGE tasks, the teacher-route student maintains 92% to 99% success across $σ=0$ to 5 mm, while six non-privileged baselines fall to 2% to 80%. A matched behaviour-cloning experiment isolates the source of this robustness. With the same student architecture, data budget, and training procedure, demonstrations generated without offset access yield only 31.5% success at $σ=5$ mm, whereas privileged and relabelled demonstrations reach 88.7% and 95.8%. Deployed zero-shot on a Franka, the student reaches 83.3% pooled success at $σ=5$ mm against 34.4% for the strongest state-based policy. Deployable sensing alone is insufficient. Robustness requires supervision that encodes compensation for the latent frame offset.Project page: https://drychang.github.io/displaced-frame/

摘要（中文）：精密装配中的位姿误差不仅会破坏机器人的观测结果，还会影响其动作所基于的坐标框架。在FORGE基准测试中，基于状态的标准策略在真实位姿下成功率达97%至99%，但在基准设定的σ=5 mm位姿噪声条件下仅有32%至60%。同一估计位姿既用于观测输入又用于锚定动作框架，导致在接触发生前仅凭本体感受状态无法辨识该偏移量。我们在训练过程中通过两种方式补充这一缺失信息：特权教师模型在仿真中观测偏移量，而干净示范则可通过闭式解重新标注到偏移后的框架中。部署的学生模型采用行为克隆后接一轮DAgger迭代进行训练，测试时仅接收含噪声状态、原始力矩窗口及两个RGB摄像头输入。在未修改的FORGE任务中，经由教师路线的学生模型在σ=0至5 mm范围内保持92%至99%的成功率，而六种非特权基线方法则降至2%至80%。一组匹配的行为克隆实验隔离了该鲁棒性的来源。在相同的学生架构、数据预算和训练流程下，未访问偏移量生成的示范在σ=5 mm时仅有31.5%的成功率，而基于特权和重新标注的示范分别达到88.7%和95.8%。在Franka机器人上零样本部署时，学生模型在σ=5 mm条件下综合成功率达83.3%，而最强的基于状态策略仅为34.4%。仅依靠可部署的传感信息是不够的。鲁棒性需要能够编码潜在框架偏移补偿的监督信号。项目页面：https://drychang.github.io/displaced-frame/

Authors: Ching-Hsiang Chang, Tzu-Yu Chuang, Yi-Hsiu Lee, Yi-Ting Chen, Yuan-Fu Yang, Min Sun

ExoBridge: Learning a Bare Hand to Hand-Worn Exoskeleton Mapping through Human Limb Coupling Manipulation

human limb coupling dexterous manipulation tactile sensing exoskeleton visual demonstrations

简要说明：ExoBridge利用双手协调，从裸手视频学习到外骨骼运动与触觉状态的映射，为灵巧机器人学习提供可扩展的监督信号。

TLDR: ExoBridge learns to map bare hand video to exoskeleton motion and tactile states using bimanual coordination, enabling scalable supervision for dexterous robot learning.

Abstract: Human video offers a scalable source of experience for dexterous robot learning, but obtaining motion and tactile supervision while preserving bare hand interaction remains challenging. We present ExoBridge, a framework that leverages human limb coupling to learn a bridging function from bare hand video to the motion and tactile state of a sensorized exoskeleton. Our central idea is to use coordinated bimanual behavior to connect an uninstrumented visual source with a measured manipulation interface. During collection, one hand remains bare and provides visual observations, while the opposite hand wears the exoskeleton and supplies synchronized motion and tactile measurements. These paired demonstrations train a temporal visual model to predict fingertip contact, continuous tactile intensity, and relative encoder motion from bare hand video alone. The exoskeleton defines an intermediate state space whose motion coordinates are linked to a dexterous robot hand through existing calibration. Evaluation on 1,215 demonstrations across four manipulation tasks uses held out collection sessions and yields a pooled any contact AUROC of 0.916 and a Pearson correlation of 0.790 for tactile intensity. The learned bridge also predicts relative changes in exoskeleton configuration from bare hand video. These results demonstrate that human limb coupling can turn exoskeleton measurements into supervision for bare hand video, establishing a learned bridge between human visual demonstrations and a robot oriented manipulation interface.

摘要（中文）：人类视频为灵巧机器人学习提供了可扩展的经验来源，但在保持裸手交互的同时获取运动与触觉监督仍具挑战性。我们提出ExoBridge框架，利用人体肢体耦合学习从裸手视频到传感外骨骼运动及触觉状态的桥梁函数。核心思想在于通过协调的双臂行为，将未装备传感器的视觉来源与可测量的操作接口相连接。在数据采集过程中，一只手保持裸露以提供视觉观测，另一只手佩戴外骨骼并同步提供运动与触觉测量数据。这些成对的演示训练了一个时序视觉模型，使其能够仅从裸手视频预测指尖接触、连续触觉强度以及相对编码器运动。外骨骼定义了一个中间状态空间，其运动坐标通过现有标定与灵巧机器人手相关联。针对四项操作任务的1，215组演示评估采用留出采集会话方式，结果获得任意接触的合并AUROC为0.916，触觉强度的皮尔逊相关系数为0.790。所习得的桥梁还能从裸手视频预测外骨骼构型的相对变化。这些结果表明，人体肢体耦合能够将外骨骼测量转化为裸手视频的监督信号，从而在人类视觉演示与面向机器人的操作接口之间建立起习得的桥梁。

Authors: Ruitong Tian, Xianyao Li, Noah B. Wilson, Fang Xu, Eric Jing Du

EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors Manipulation

dexterous manipulation exploration human priors reinforcement learning trajectory optimization

简要说明：本文研究了人类运动先验在灵巧操作中的有效性，发现其最适合用于构建探索结构而非改变动作空间，并提出了EigenDEXplore方法，该方法沿人类特征向量添加相关扰动到独立的关节空间噪声中，在多种灵巧操作任务和设置中提高了性能。

TLDR: This paper investigates the effectiveness of human-motion priors in dexterous manipulation, finding they are best used to structure exploration rather than alter the action space, and introduces EigenDEXplore, a method that adds correlated perturbations along human-derived eigenvectors to independent joint-space noise, improving performance across various dexterous manipulation tasks and settings.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation poses a challenging high-dimensional optimization problem, as useful behaviors require coordinated motion across many hand joints. In reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based trajectory optimization, exploration commonly relies on independent robot joint perturbations, making coordinated behaviors difficult to discover. Prior work reduces this search space for grasp learning using low-dimensional spaces of coordinated joint motions learned from human hand data, but this restricts the expressivity required for general manipulation. Some combine learned and joint-space actions to restore expressivity, but this increases dimensionality and introduces redundancy. We study these effects across diverse manipulation settings, varying action dimensionality, exploration strategy, and the source of human data. Our experiments suggest that human-motion priors are most effective when used to structure exploration rather than change the action representation. Motivated by this finding, we propose EigenDEXplore, which induces correlated exploration by adding perturbations along human-derived eigenvectors to independent joint-space noise, leaving the action space unchanged. Across multiple dexterous hands, EigenDEXplore consistently outperforms joint-space and learned action-space baselines in grasping, in-hand reorientation, and contact-rich manipulation. These gains span unstructured and reference-guided RL, trajectory optimization, and sim-to-real deployment, and are largest in settings with less reward shaping and curriculum design.

摘要（中文）：灵巧操作是一个具有挑战性的高维优化问题，因为有效的行为需要多个手部关节的协调运动。在强化学习和基于采样的轨迹优化中，探索通常依赖于独立的机器人关节扰动，这使得协调行为的发现变得困难。以往的研究通过使用从人类手部数据中学习到的协调关节运动低维空间来缩小抓取学习的搜索空间，但这限制了通用操作所需的表达能力。部分研究将学习到的动作与关节空间动作相结合以恢复表达能力，但这增加了维度并引入了冗余。我们在多种操作场景中研究了这些影响，变化了动作维度、探索策略以及人类数据的来源。实验结果表明，人类运动先验在用于构建探索结构而非改变动作表示时效果最佳。基于这一发现，我们提出了EigenDEXplore，该方法通过在独立关节空间噪声上叠加沿人类特征向量的扰动来引入相关性探索，同时保持动作空间不变。在多种灵巧手上，EigenDEXplore在抓取、手内重定向和接触丰富操作中均 consistently 优于关节空间和学习的动作空间基线方法。这些优势涵盖了无结构的和参考引导的强化学习、轨迹优化以及仿真到现实的部署，并且在奖励塑造和课程设计较少的环境中提升最为显著。

Authors: Harsh Gupta, Tyler Ga Wei Lum, Changhao Wang, Chuer Pan, C. Karen Liu, Jeannette Bohg, Shuran Song

SMART: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Articulated Object Manipulation via Large-Scale Synthetic Pretraining Manipulation

articulated object manipulation zero-shot sim-to-real synthetic demonstrations VLA pretraining simulation platform

简要说明：SMART提出了一个可扩展的仿真平台和大规模合成演示流水线，用于铰接物体操作，预训练的VLA模型在真实机器人上实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: SMART introduces a scalable simulation platform and large-scale synthetic demonstration pipeline for articulated-object manipulation, pretraining a VLA model that achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on real robots.

Abstract: The ability to interact with articulated objects is essential for embodied intelligent systems, but collecting large-scale real-world demonstrations for these interactions remains challenging due to the precise contact and constraint-following motions involved. Although simulation provides a promising alternative, existing synthetic data efforts cover limited articulated-object categories, while general-purpose synthesis pipelines lack explicit designs for part-level semantics and articulation constraints, hindering agentic task generation and scalable synthesis of high-quality articulated-manipulation demonstrations. To bridge this gap, we introduce SMART, a scalable system leveraging large-scale Synthesized Manipulation demonstrations for ARTiculated-object manipulation. At its core, we develop SMART-Sim, a simulation platform with articulation-aware design that enables effective task generation and efficient demonstration collection. Building on SMART-Sim, we apply agentic task generation and design a scalable distributed synthesis system, using them to synthesize SMART-Data, comprising over 1M demonstrations across 44 atomic task types, 5 robot setups, and 2,507 articulated objects. The vision-language-action (VLA) model pretrained on SMART-Data shows competitive performance on simulation benchmarks and achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and scalable performance in real-world articulated-object manipulation tasks. This highlights the potential of synthetic demonstrations in providing effective and scalable supervision for improving VLA model performance in contact-rich articulated-object manipulation.

摘要（中文）：与铰接物体交互的能力对于具身智能系统至关重要，但由于此类交互涉及精确的接触和约束跟随运动，大规模采集真实世界演示数据仍颇具挑战。尽管仿真提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但现有合成数据工作覆盖的铰接物体类别有限，而通用合成流程缺乏对部件级语义和铰接约束的显式设计，这阻碍了智能体任务的生成以及高质量铰接操作演示的可扩展合成。为弥合这一差距，我们提出SMART，一个利用大规模合成操作演示进行铰接物体操作的可扩展系统。其核心是SMART-Sim，一个具有铰接感知设计的仿真平台，能够实现高效的任务生成和高效的演示收集。基于SMART-Sim，我们应用智能体任务生成并设计了一个可扩展的分布式合成系统，利用这些系统合成SMART-Data，涵盖44种原子任务类型、5种机器人配置和2,507个铰接物体上的超过100万条演示。在SMART-Data上预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在仿真基准测试中表现出具有竞争力的性能，并在真实世界铰接物体操作任务中实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移以及可扩展的性能。这凸显了合成演示在提供有效且可扩展的监督以提升VLA模型在接触丰富的铰接物体操作中的性能方面的潜力。

Authors: Jicong Ao, Shuhan Jiang, Yuling Zhong, Yanwen Liu, Yuhan Gao, Jiangyuan Zhao, Yang Zhang, Shiqiang Zhu, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

TacZero: Training-Free Peg Insertion Using a General-Purpose Vision-Language Model with Tactile Feedback Manipulation

Vision-Language Model Tactile Feedback Contact-rich Manipulation Peg Insertion Training-free

简要说明：TacZero利用预训练的通用视觉语言模型与触觉反馈，在无需特定任务训练的情况下完成插销任务，真实世界中触觉输入下成功率为15/20，无触觉时为10/20。

TLDR: TacZero uses a pretrained general-purpose VLM with tactile feedback to perform peg insertion without task-specific training, achieving 15/20 real-world successes with tactile input versus 10/20 without.

Abstract: Robots that autonomously determine their actions from language instructions and sensory observations could perform new contact-rich manipulation tasks without task-specific training or hand-designed rules. To perform these tasks, robots must infer how objects contact one another and move as a result, then select actions. For contact inference and action selection, prior approaches involve designing estimation models and tactile feedback control laws, or learning models for object-motion estimation, action-outcome prediction, and action selection from tactile data. Instead, we propose TacZero, which uses a pretrained general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) to interpret visual and tactile observations and select robot actions without additional tactile or manipulation training or task-specific rules for contact interpretation or action selection. TacZero provides the VLM with camera images, robot state, and three-axis tactile responses represented as numerical values or vectors overlaid on the images. From these observations and interaction history, the VLM generates commands specifying target end-effector positions and gripper opening or closing, which a low-level controller executes. In real-world cylindrical-peg insertion experiments, TacZero succeeded in 15 of 20 trials with numerical tactile input, compared with 10 of 20 without tactile input. This study provides a concrete starting point for further research on contact-rich manipulation using general-purpose VLMs and highlights challenges in pursuing this direction.

摘要（中文）：自主机器人若能从语言指令与感官观测中自主决定动作，将能执行新的接触密集操作任务，而无需针对特定任务的训练或人工设计规则。为完成这些任务，机器人必须先推断物体之间的接触方式及其引发的运动，再选择相应动作。在接触推断与动作选择方面，以往的研究方法包括设计估计模型与触觉反馈控制律，或从触觉数据中学习物体运动估计、动作结果预测及动作选择模型。与此不同，我们提出TacZero方法，利用预训练的通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）来解读视觉与触觉观测，并选择机器人动作，无需额外的触觉或操作训练，也无需针对接触解读或动作选择的特定任务规则。TacZero将摄像头图像、机器人状态及以数值或叠加在图像上的向量形式呈现的三轴触觉响应输入VLM。基于这些观测与交互历史，VLM生成指定目标末端执行器位置及夹爪开闭的指令，由底层控制器执行。在真实世界的圆柱形插销插入实验中，采用数值触觉输入时，TacZero在20次试验中成功15次，而无触觉输入时为20次中成功10次。本研究为利用通用VLM进行接触密集操作提供了具体的起点，并揭示了在该方向上继续探索所面临的挑战。

Authors: Kazutoshi Tanaka

Modeling Latent Disturbances for Robust Decision-Making in World Models WorldModel

latent disturbance robust optimization conformal prediction world models policy steering

简要说明：本文提出了一种在世界模型潜空间中通过模拟悲观但合理的潜在扰动来进行鲁棒决策的方法，利用共形预测校准不确定集并采用博弈论优化，在Franka机械臂上验证了显著降低失败率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for robust decision-making in the latent space of world models by modeling latent disturbances as pessimistic but plausible transitions, calibrated with conformal prediction and optimized via game-theoretic optimization, demonstrating reduced failures on a Franka manipulator.

Abstract: In this paper, we study robust decision-making in the latent space of world models (WMs). Robust optimization is a mathematical framework where, given explicitly specified dynamics and physically meaningful disturbances, a robot can select actions that remain effective even under worst-case disturbances. However, applying this principle to the learned latent space of WMs introduces a fundamental challenge: because WMs have fully learned state spaces and dynamics inferred from high-dimensional observations, it is unclear how to define latent-space disturbances that faithfully represent uncertainty in the underlying system. Our key idea is to model a latent-space disturbance as a perturbation to the learned latent dynamics that induces pessimistic but plausible transitions. Specifically, we construct a set of plausible latent dynamics by combining a dynamics-aware similarity metric that captures plausible transitions with out-of-distribution detection that excludes implausible latent states. We calibrate this uncertainty set over latent dynamics using conformal prediction, ensuring that WM imaginations induced by the latent disturbance remain plausible without becoming overly pessimistic. We then jointly optimize robust robot actions and the worst-case latent disturbances through game-theoretic optimization. We leverage this latent-space robust optimization to robustify policy steering, considering two paradigms: latent safety filtering and sample-and-verify steering of a generative control policy. Our controlled simulation experiments show that our latent disturbance enables robust decision-making directly in WM latent spaces, and hardware experiments with a Franka manipulator show that modeling latent disturbances enables robust policy steering, reducing failures by 70% in safety filtering and 54% in sampling-based policy steering. Project website: https://junwon.me/LatentDisturbance/.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了世界模型（WMs）潜空间中的鲁棒决策问题。鲁棒优化是一种数学框架，在给定明确指定的动力学模型和具有物理意义的扰动条件下，机器人能够选择即使在最坏情况扰动下依然有效的动作。然而，将这一原理应用于世界模型的学习潜空间带来了一个根本性挑战：由于世界模型的状态空间和动力学完全是从高维观测中学习得到的，因此如何定义能够准确反映底层系统不确定性的潜空间扰动尚不明确。我们的核心思想是将潜空间扰动建模为对学习得到的潜动力学的扰动，从而诱发悲观但合理的状态转移。具体而言，我们通过结合能够捕捉合理转移的动力学感知相似度度量与能够排除不合理潜状态的分布外检测，构建了一组合理的潜动力学集合。我们利用保形预测对该潜动力学上的不确定集进行校准，确保由潜扰动引发的大模型想象保持合理性而不过度悲观。随后，我们通过博弈论优化联合优化鲁棒机器人动作和最坏情况潜扰动。我们利用这种潜空间鲁棒优化来增强策略引导的鲁棒性，考虑两种范式：潜安全滤波和生成控制策略的采样-验证引导。我们的受控仿真实验表明，所提出的潜扰动能够直接在世界模型潜空间中实现鲁棒决策；使用Franka机械臂进行的硬件实验表明，对潜扰动的建模能够实现鲁棒策略引导，在安全滤波中将失败率降低70%，在基于采样的策略引导中降低54%。项目网站：https://junwon.me/LatentDisturbance/。

Authors: Junwon Seo, Andrea Bajcsy

BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid household manipulation VLA fine-tuning imitation learning demo-driven reinforcement learning whole-body controller

简要说明：BiGym 2.0 将 BiGym 基准测试适配到 Unitree G1 人形机器人，提供 20 个家庭任务及原生人类演示和统一全身控制器，并对 VLA 微调、模仿学习、演示驱动的强化学习和编码智能体进行基准测试。

TLDR: BiGym 2.0 adapts the BiGym benchmark to the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, providing 20 household tasks with native human demonstrations and a unified whole-body controller, and benchmarks VLA fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven RL, and coding agents.

Abstract: Humanoid household manipulation requires the arms to act while the body balances, steps and changes posture. We present BiGym 2.0, an adaptation of BiGym for the Unitree G1 across 20 household tasks using a unified whole-body controller for demonstration and evaluation. The suite provides 60 native human virtual-reality demonstrations per task with synchronised multi-camera views and full-body execution records. We benchmark vision-language-action fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning, and cold-start coding agents given the interaction budget of online reinforcement learning. With the same onboard views, proprioception and whole-body controller for every method, vision-language-action fine-tuning has the highest nine-task mean, and agent-developed programs outperform every demo-driven reinforcement learning baseline on this mean and lead on bimanual reaching. Cross-workspace stacking remains open, $π_{0.5}$ stays low on pick-box, and multi-object transport is hard for imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning and coding agents. All environments, human demonstrations, and evaluation traces are open-sourced at https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2.

摘要（中文）：类人家庭操作要求手臂在执行动作的同时，身体需要保持平衡、迈步并调整姿态。我们提出了BiGym 2.0，这是BiGym针对Unitree G1的适配版本，涵盖20项家庭任务，采用统一的全身体控制器进行演示和评估。该套件为每项任务提供了60个原生人类虚拟现实演示，并配套同步的多视角摄像头数据及全身执行记录。在在线强化学习的交互预算下，我们对视觉-语言-动作微调、模仿学习、演示驱动的强化学习以及冷启动编码智能体进行了基准测试。在每种方法均使用相同的机载视角、本体感知和全身体控制器的条件下，视觉-语言-动作微调在九项任务的平均表现上最高，而智能体开发的程序在该平均值上优于所有基于演示的强化学习基线，并在双臂到达任务中领先。跨工作空间堆叠任务仍未解决，$π_{0.5}$在取箱任务上得分依然较低，而多物体搬运对模仿学习、演示驱动的强化学习及编码智能体而言均具有挑战性。所有环境、人类演示及评估轨迹均已开源，见https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2。

Authors: Zexi Zhang, Zecheng Zhu, Zidong Chen, Zulkhuu Tuya, Stephen James

Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation VLA

Vision-Language-Action visual prompting navigation radiation avoidance thermal avoidance

简要说明：PG-VP是一种即插即用的多模态感知模块，通过物理引导的风险评估在RGB帧上叠加动态虚拟障碍物，使冻结的VLA导航策略无需重新训练即可避开不可见的热/辐射危险。

TLDR: PG-VP is a plug-and-play multimodal perception module that overlays dynamic virtual obstacles on RGB frames based on physics-guided risk assessment, enabling frozen VLA navigation policies to avoid invisible thermal/radiation hazards without retraining.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a major paradigm for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN). However, in safety-critical facilities, invisible risks such as radiation or temperature spikes cannot be detected by an RGB camera, and handling each risk is expensive, requiring a new encoder, new data, and model retraining. We propose Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP), a plug-and-play multimodal perception module that instead reuses what a frozen VLA model already does well: avoiding visible obstacles. Given a proximal radiation or thermal source, PG-VP performs a physics-guided risk assessment to determine the avoidance direction and overlays a corresponding virtual obstacle that moves across consecutive frames (Dynamic Visual Prompting). The navigation policy then naturally detours around this invisible hazard. The identical virtual obstacle is used regardless of hazard type, so the visual prompting pattern remains fixed as sensors are added. When no hazard is detected, nothing is rendered, and the policy behaves exactly as it would without PG-VP. We evaluate PG-VP on OmniNav using the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, where it guides the policy toward intended low-risk actions in 84.9% and 83.2% of cases, at a cost of 6.8 and 7.9 percentage points in navigation success rate. We further test it with distinct scenarios on a real robot in the presence of actual thermal and radiation sources, all without any retraining. The real test shows that PG-VP effectively avoids these invisible hazards, improving worst-10% average trajectory safety by 63.45% and 32.59% against thermal and radiation sources, respectively.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为视觉与语言导航（VLN）领域的主要范式。然而，在安全关键设施中，辐射或温度骤升等不可见风险无法通过RGB相机检测到，且应对每种风险代价高昂，需配备新的编码器、新数据及模型重训练。我们提出物理引导的视觉提示（PG-VP），这是一种即插即用的多模态感知模块，通过复用冻结的VLA模型已擅长的能力——避开可见障碍物——来规避上述问题。给定近距离辐射源或热源，PG-VP执行物理引导的风险评估以确定规避方向，并叠加相应的虚拟障碍物，该障碍物在连续帧中移动（动态视觉提示）。导航策略随后自然绕开这一不可见危险。无论危险类型如何，均使用相同的虚拟障碍物，因此随着传感器的增加，视觉提示模式保持不变。当未检测到危险时，不渲染任何内容，策略行为与未使用PG-VP时完全一致。我们在OmniNav上使用R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen分割对PG-VP进行评估，在84.9%和83.2%的情况下引导策略走向预期的低风险动作，导航成功率代价分别为6.8和7.9个百分点。我们进一步在真实机器人上，面对实际热源和辐射源的多种场景进行测试，全程无需任何重训练。实际测试表明，PG-VP有效规避这些不可见危险，在热源和辐射源场景下，最差10%平均轨迹安全性分别提升63.45%和32.59%。

Authors: Hojoon Son, Fan Zhang

Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning Manipulation

task-space imitation reward construction reinforcement learning tabletop manipulation sample efficiency

简要说明：TIGER是一种奖励构建和预训练框架，利用动作分块模仿策略作为任务空间进度估计器，为稀疏奖励桌面机器人操作提供密集的进度奖励，提高RL的样本效率和安全性。

TLDR: TIGER is a reward-construction and pretraining framework that uses an action-chunked imitation policy as a task-space progress estimator to provide dense progress rewards for sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation, improving sample efficiency and safety in RL.

Abstract: We introduce Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning (TIGER), a reward-construction and pretraining framework for sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation. TIGER treats an action-chunked imitation policy not as an executable controller or action prior, but as a local task-space progress estimator: predicted action chunks are converted, using controller-aware action-to-motion mapping, into short-horizon end-effector references, and the RL agent receives dense progress rewards toward these references while the sparse environment reward remains the dominant objective. During pretraining, TIGER uses imitation-guided look-ahead signals to relax conservative value penalties for actions predicted to make task-space progress, reducing off-manifold exploration during early online RL. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, TIGER improves early sample efficiency and reduces measured safety violations while matching or improving final success rates relative to prior RL and IL-RL baselines on the evaluated tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：我们提出了任务空间模仿引导的高效强化学习框架（TIGER），该框架面向稀疏奖励桌面机器人操作任务，融合了奖励构建与预训练机制。TIGER并未将基于动作分块的模仿策略视为可执行的控制器或动作先验，而是将其用作局部任务空间进度估计器：通过考虑控制器特性的动作到运动映射，将预测的动作块转换为短时域末端执行器参考，强化学习智能体则朝着这些参考获得密集的进度奖励，同时稀疏的环境奖励仍作为主导目标。在预训练阶段，TIGER利用模仿引导的前瞻信号，对经预测能够带来任务空间进展的动作放宽保守价值惩罚，从而减少在线强化学习早期的流形外探索。在仿真和真实机器人实验中，与所评估任务上的既有强化学习及模仿学习-强化学习基线相比，TIGER在提升早期样本效率、减少实测安全违规次数的同时，最终成功率保持持平或有所提升。

Authors: Salar Asayesh, Hossein Darani, Todd Cao, Evgeny Andriash, Mani Ranjbar

ReDex: Repairing Sim-to-Real Dexterous Policies by Finger-Level Compliant Interaction Manipulation

sim-to-real dexterous manipulation tactile feedback behavior cloning compliant control

简要说明：ReDex 通过在柔顺控制下允许人类修正手指级别的接触失败，然后通过行为克隆训练力条件策略，来适配仿真到现实的灵巧操作策略，显著提高了真实世界中的物体翻转和螺丝刀旋转成功率。

TLDR: ReDex adapts sim-to-real dexterous manipulation policies by allowing human correction of finger-level contact failures under compliant control, then trains a force-conditioned policy via behavior cloning, significantly improving real-world success rates on object flipping and screwdriver rotation.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world because of errors in contact timing and force regulation. Yet these policies can retain useful multi-finger coordination for task progression. We propose ReDex, a framework for adapting a simulation-trained base policy to the real world by correcting local contact failures and incorporating tactile feedback. Starting from a proprioception-only base policy, ReDex allows a human operator to physically correct contact failures at selected fingers under compliant control during real-world rollouts, while the frozen base policy continues to control the remaining fingers. These rollouts combine base policy execution, human-corrected finger motion, and fingertip force observations. We reconstruct force-informed targets from these rollouts to train a standalone force-conditioned policy via behavior cloning. This design reduces human correction effort, enables learning of contact regulation from real-world interaction, and introduces force feedback into a proprioception-only policy without tactile simulation or complex full-hand teleoperation. We evaluate ReDex on two challenging, contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on real hardware. Compared with sim-to-real transferred base policies, ReDex increases Object Flipping success rate from 14\% to 86\% across two objects and average Screwdriver Rotation progress from 26.0% to 95.3% across three objects.

摘要（中文）：在仿真中训练的灵巧操作策略，常因接触时机与力控制误差而难以成功迁移至现实世界。然而，此类策略仍可为任务推进保留有效的多指协调能力。为此，我们提出ReDex框架，通过纠正局部接触失败并结合触觉反馈，将仿真训练的基础策略适配至现实环境。ReDex从仅依赖本体感觉的基础策略出发，在现实部署过程中，允许操作员在顺应控制下对选定手指的接触失败进行物理纠正，而其余手指仍由冻结的基础策略控制。这些部署过程融合了基础策略的执行、人工纠正的手指运动以及指尖力观测数据。我们基于这些数据重构出力信息目标，并通过行为克隆训练独立的力条件策略。该设计减少了人工纠正工作量，使策略能够从真实交互中学习接触调节，并在无需触觉仿真或复杂全手遥操作的情况下，将力反馈引入仅依赖本体感觉的策略中。我们在真实硬件上针对两项高难度、接触密集的灵巧操作任务对ReDex进行评估。与直接进行仿真到现实迁移的基础策略相比，ReDex在两个物体上的Object Flipping成功率从14%提升至86%，在三个物体上的Screwdriver Rotation平均进展从26.0%提升至95.3%。

Authors: Jinzhou Li, Hadi Tabatabaee, Kelin Yu, Yuyin Sun, Cheng-Hao Kuo, Roberto Martín-Martín, Nima Fazeli, X. Alice Wu, Xianyi Cheng

MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

data augmentation pose generalization mobile manipulation egocentric vision humanoid

简要说明：MobileVISTA 是一个数据增强框架，从规范演示中生成位姿扰动的训练数据，提高移动操作器对分布外基座位姿的鲁棒性，无需额外数据收集或生成模型。

TLDR: MobileVISTA is a data augmentation framework that generates pose-perturbed training data from canonical demonstrations for mobile manipulators, improving robustness to out-of-distribution base poses without extra data collection or generative models.

Abstract: Mobile manipulators such as humanoid robots are increasingly deployed in dynamic, unstructured environments to perform dexterous manipulation tasks. However, end-to-end manipulation policies trained to imitate demonstration data collected from a single robot pose are brittle: even centimeter-scale deviations in robot pose at deployment can drive ego-centric observations and end-effector trajectories out of the training distribution, leading to sharp drops in performance. We introduce MobileVISTA, a data generation framework that transforms demonstrations captured at canonical poses into diverse, pose-perturbed training data by jointly (1) augmenting egocentric visual observations and (2) retargeting actions to compensate for base pose changes. Unlike prior methods, which assume a camera rigidly mounted off the actuated chain or non-trivial articulated robot geometry largely out of frame, MobileVISTA targets compatibility with egocentric platforms (e.g., humanoids) where the camera is both influenced by and must observe the robot's kinematic chain as it moves. We study MobileVISTA in simulated tasks spanning humanoid and bimanual embodiments, and on a real Galaxea R1 Pro. We find policies trained on MobileVISTA-augmented data demonstrate improved robustness to previously out-of-distribution poses encountered at test time, without additional demonstration collection or a trained generative model. Additionally, we find MobileVISTA's benefit is largest on tested humanoids, where the camera rides the actuated chain and the robot fills much of the frame. Additional videos and appendix can be found on our website: https://mobilevista.github.io

摘要（中文）：移动操作机器人（如人形机器人）正越来越多地被部署在动态、非结构化环境中，以执行灵巧操作任务。然而，基于从单一机器人位姿采集的示范数据训练得到的端到端操作策略往往较为脆弱：即使在部署时机器人位姿出现厘米级偏差，也会导致以自我为中心的视觉观察和末端执行器轨迹偏离训练数据分布，从而造成性能急剧下降。我们提出MobileVISTA，一种数据生成框架，通过联合（1）增强自我中心视觉观察和（2）重新定向动作以补偿基座位姿变化，将规范位姿下采集的示范数据转化为多样化的、位姿扰动训练数据。与以往假设相机刚性安装于非驱动链上或假设非平凡关节机器人几何结构大部分位于画面之外的方法不同，MobileVISTA旨在兼容自我中心平台（如人形机器人），在这些平台上，相机既受机器人运动学链影响，又必须在机器人运动时观察到该链。我们在涵盖人形和双臂形态的模拟任务中以及真实Galaxea R1 Pro平台上研究了MobileVISTA。我们发现，基于MobileVISTA增强数据训练的策略在测试时遇到的先前分布外位姿上表现出更强的鲁棒性，且无需额外采集示范数据或训练生成模型。此外，我们发现MobileVISTA在测试的人形机器人上收益最大，因为在该类平台上相机位于驱动链上且机器人占据画面大部分区域。更多视频和附录请访问我们的网站：https://mobilevista.github.io

Authors: Suzannah Wistreich, Stephen Tian, Isabella Huang, Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini, Sergey Zakharov, Katherine Liu, Jiajun Wu

Risk-Sensitive Crowd Navigation with Adaptive Ellipsoidal Conformal Prediction Other

crowd navigation conformal prediction conditional value-at-risk distribution shift Lagrangian PPO

简要说明：本文提出一种风险感知的人群导航框架，利用各向异性共形椭球和CVaR调节的Lagrangian PPO来处理分布偏移，在OOD场景中提高成功率并降低碰撞率，并在真实机器人上部署。

TLDR: This paper introduces a risk-aware crowd navigation framework using anisotropic conformal ellipsoids and CVaR-regulated Lagrangian PPO to handle distribution shifts, improving success rates and reducing collisions in OOD settings, with real-robot deployment.

Abstract: Safe crowd navigation under distribution shift requires uncertainty representations that capture structured human-motion prediction errors and safety objectives that account for rare but consequential failures. Existing uncertainty-aware methods typically represent prediction errors using isotropic regions, which can be either overly conservative or poorly aligned with directional motion uncertainty. We introduce a risk-aware navigation framework that uses anisotropic conformal ellipsoids to translate structured prediction uncertainty into an episode-level conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) signal that regulates the Lagrangian safety penalty. In particular, adaptive ellipsoidal conformal prediction (AECP) captures directional prediction errors and adaptively calibrates uncertainty regions under distribution shift, while the resulting CVaR-regulated navigation policy is optimized using Lagrangian proximal policy optimization. We evaluate our proposed method under both in-distribution settings and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings involving shifts in pedestrian motion patterns. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our method maintains competitive in-distribution performance while improving success rates by 5.68-7.44 percentage points and reducing collision rates by 5.44-6.64 percentage points across OOD settings. We further deploy the trained policy without fine-tuning on a physical robot with onboard perception and CPU-only inference, showing that the full pipeline is feasible in physical crowd navigation.

摘要（中文）：分布偏移下的安全人群导航需要不确定性表示来捕捉结构化的行人运动预测误差，以及能够考虑罕见但后果严重的安全目标。现有不确定性感知方法通常使用各向同性区域来表示预测误差，这些区域要么过于保守，要么与方向性运动不确定性对齐不良。我们提出了一种风险感知导航框架，使用各向异性共形椭球体将结构化预测不确定性转化为情节级条件风险价值（CVaR）信号，用于调节拉格朗日安全惩罚。具体而言，自适应椭球共形预测（AECP）捕捉方向性预测误差，并在分布偏移下自适应校准不确定性区域，而由此产生的CVaR调节导航策略则使用拉格朗日近端策略优化进行优化。我们在分布内设置和涉及行人运动模式偏移的分布外（OOD）设置下评估了所提出的方法。与最先进的基线方法相比，我们的方法在保持具有竞争力的分布内性能的同时，在OOD设置下将成功率提高了5.68-7.44个百分点，并将碰撞率降低了5.44-6.64个百分点。我们进一步将训练好的策略无需微调直接部署于带有板载感知和仅CPU推理的实体机器人上，表明完整流程在物理人群导航中切实可行。

Authors: Ruihan A. Li, Ziyao Guo, Yingying Li

RACER: Residual-Adaptive Closed-Loop Estimation for Sampling-Based Planning in Wheeled-Quadruped Racing Locomotion

wheeled-quadruped racing MPPI planner residual dynamics model RL velocity tracker Low-Rank Residual Adaptation (LoRRA)

简要说明：RACER提出了一种用于轮式四足机器人赛车的分层控制框架，结合MPPI规划器、学习残差动力学模型和低级RL速度跟踪器，并通过低秩残差适应（LoRRA）从仿真高效微调到现实世界。

TLDR: RACER presents a hierarchical control framework for wheeled-quadruped racing, combining an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and a low-level RL velocity tracker, using Low-Rank Residual Adaptation (LoRRA) for efficient fine-tuning from simulation to real-world.

Abstract: We present RACER, a hierarchical control framework for wheel-based quadruped racing that combines an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and a low-level RL velocity tracker. The planner augments a nominal unicycle kinematic model with a neural residual term to capture the closed-loop tracking behavior of the RL policy. To train this residual model under limited real-world data, we propose Low-Rank Residual Adaptation (LoRRA), a two-stage approach that pre-trains on large-scale simulation data for broad coverage and then fine-tunes on a small real-world dataset with a low-rank constraint. In simulation, we empirically validate our engineering choices by showing (A) Residual dynamics improve the overall performance of our pipeline by capturing the tracking error of RL velocity tracker at high-speed cornering. (B) Residual dynamics trained with both source-domain and target-domain data gives racing performance significantly better than the residual dynamics trained with only target-domain data. (C) Low-rank constraint at target-domain adaptation gives higher success rates and higher performance than full-tune and from-scratch when domain gap in ground coefficient or joint gain increases.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了RACER，一种用于轮式四足机器人竞速的分层控制框架，该框架将MPPI规划器与学习得到的残差动力学模型以及底层RL速度跟踪器相结合。规划器在名义上的单轮运动学模型基础上增加了一个神经残差项，以捕捉RL策略的闭环跟踪行为。为了在有限的现实世界数据下训练该残差模型，我们提出了低秩残差自适应（LoRRA）方法，这是一种两阶段方法：首先在大规模仿真数据上进行预训练以获得广泛的覆盖能力，然后在少量现实世界数据集上采用低秩约束进行微调。在仿真中，我们通过实验验证了我们的工程选择，结果表明：（A）残差动力学通过捕捉高速转弯时RL速度跟踪器的跟踪误差，提升了整个流水线的整体性能。（B）使用源域和目标域数据共同训练的残差动力学，在竞速性能上显著优于仅使用目标域数据训练的残差动力学。（C）当地面摩擦系数或关节增益的域差异增大时，目标域自适应阶段的低秩约束相比全参数微调和从零训练，能够带来更高的成功率和更好的性能。

Parallel Predictive World Models for Accurate and Efficient Long-Horizon Planning WorldModel

parallel prediction world model planning causal trajectory prediction Cross-Entropy Method visual control

简要说明：本文提出了并行预测世界模型（PPWM），在保持未来表征之间因果交互的同时并行预测有限时域轨迹，在视觉控制任务中相比自回归基线实现了更低的预测误差、更高的规划成功率和超过3倍的加速。

TLDR: This paper introduces Parallel Predictive World Models (PPWM), which predict finite-horizon trajectories in parallel while maintaining causal interactions among future representations, achieving lower prediction error, higher planning success, and over 3x speedup compared to autoregressive baselines in visual-control tasks.

Abstract: Long-horizon world-model planning typically relies on autoregressive rollouts, where predicted states are repeatedly fed back into the model. This preserves temporal structure but creates a horizon-length sequential path and exposes later predictions to recursive decoded-state feedback. We introduce Parallel Predictive World Models (PPWM), which predict a finite-horizon trajectory in parallel while retaining causal interaction among future representations. Each horizon is conditioned on its causal action prefix, and future representations interact before decoding, separating temporal causality from state-by-state output recursion. We formalize this distinction by viewing autoregressive rollout as a causal trajectory map and identifying the decoded-state feedback pathway removed by PPWM. Across four visual-control tasks, PPWM achieves the lowest long-horizon prediction error and the highest Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) simulator success among the evaluated predictive interfaces. Meanwhile, PPWM achieves more than a 3$\times$ average CEM planning speedup over the autoregressive LeWM baseline. These results suggest that accurate and efficient long-horizon world-model planning does not require state-by-state autoregression, but can instead be achieved through parallel causal trajectory prediction.

摘要（中文）：长期视界世界模型规划通常依赖于自回归展开，其中预测状态被反复反馈至模型中。这种方法保持了时间结构，但形成了长度等于视界长度的顺序路径，并使后续预测暴露于递归解码状态的反馈中。我们提出了并行预测世界模型（PPWM），该模型并行预测有限视界轨迹，同时保留未来表征之间的因果交互。每个视界步骤以其因果动作前缀为条件，未来表征在解码前进行交互，从而将时间因果性与逐状态输出递归分离。我们通过将自回归展开视为因果轨迹映射，并识别PPWM所去除的解码状态反馈路径，形式化了这一区别。在四个视觉控制任务中，PPWM在评估的预测接口中实现了最低的长期视界预测误差和最高的交叉熵方法（CEM）模拟器成功率。同时，PPWM相较于自回归LeWM基线实现了平均超过3倍的CEM规划加速。这些结果表明，准确且高效的长期视界世界模型规划并不需要逐状态自回归，而可以通过并行因果轨迹预测来实现。

Authors: Wanjin Feng, Baobin Zhang, Ao Yu, Shibo Feng, Xi Wang, Xingyu Gao

Grounding What Shapes the Plan: Rethinking Groundedness for Physical Intelligence in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

grounded planning entity-centric reasoning autonomous driving open-loop planning closed-loop simulation

简要说明：GroundAct 为自动驾驶引入了以实体为中心的落地规划方法，将推理锚定于物理实体及其交互以修正规划，并在开环和闭环场景中展现了强大性能。

TLDR: GroundAct introduces entity-centric grounded planning for autonomous driving, where reasoning is anchored to physical entities and their interactions to correct the plan, and demonstrates strong open- and closed-loop results.

Abstract: Driving models increasingly ground reasoning in causal relations, spatial structure, perceptual evidence, and predicted futures. These advances make reasoning more faithful to the driving scene, but leave a fundamental question unresolved: what should groundedness mean when the model ultimately outputs an action? Correctly grounded reasoning does not, by itself, ensure desirable driving outcomes. We introduce GroundAct, which starts from a simple premise: driving unfolds through physical entities and their interactions. Entities therefore become the unit of grounding; a lightweight reference token keeps each selected entity's continuous state addressable through symbolic reasoning; and only the referenced entities' interactions with the evolving proposal correct the plan. The result is an explicit path from what reasoning grounds to what the plan does, which we call grounded planning. To assess its practical value, we evaluate GroundAct in both open- and closed-loop settings. GroundAct shows strong open-loop planning across normal, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical scenarios, with closed-loop results extending this evidence to driving in simulation.

摘要（中文）：驾驶模型日益将推理建立在因果关系、空间结构、感知证据及预测未来之上。这些进展使推理更贴近驾驶场景，但一个根本性问题仍未解决：当模型最终输出一个动作时，“有根据”究竟应意味着什么？仅凭有根据的推理，并不足以确保理想的驾驶结果。为此，我们提出GroundAct，其出发点简洁明了：驾驶过程通过物理实体及其相互作用展开。因此，实体成为推理的基本单元；一个轻量级的参考标记确保每个选定实体的连续状态在符号推理中保持可寻址；唯有被引用实体与不断演进的方案之间的交互，才对计划进行修正。由此，我们构建了一条从推理所依据的内容到计划实际执行内容的显式路径，称之为“有依据的规划”。为评估其实用价值，我们在开环与闭环两种设置下对GroundAct进行评测。结果显示，GroundAct在常规、分布外及安全关键场景中均展现出强大的开环规划能力，而闭环结果进一步将这一证据延伸至仿真驾驶环境。

Authors: Minkyoung Cho, Zewei Zhou, Wenhao Ding, Shuhan Tan, Boyi Li, Yuxiao Chen, Yan Wang, Zheng Lian, Min-Hung Chen, Chaowei Xiao, Zhuoqing Mao, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone, Yulong Cao

Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection AutonomousDriving

cooperative perception 3D object detection bandwidth-efficient packet-loss recovery latency-aware alignment

简要说明：本文提出Sparse2comm，一种面向自动驾驶的带宽高效且鲁棒的协同3D目标检测框架，通过稀疏特征编码、延迟感知对齐和自校准融合来应对不可靠通信（丢包、延迟、错位），在混合退化下展现出稳健性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient cooperative 3D object detection framework for autonomous driving that tackles unreliable communication (packet loss, latency, misalignment) through sparse feature encoding, latency-aware alignment, and self-calibrating fusion, demonstrating robust performance under mixed degradations.

Abstract: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

摘要（中文）：协同感知通过共享车辆与路侧基础设施之间的互补观测信息，提升了三维目标检测的自动驾驶性能。然而，实际部署受限于有限带宽与不可靠协作条件，其中数据包丢失、传输延迟和空间错位共同导致协作特征流质量下降。现有方法通常仅降低通信成本或仅补偿单一劣化类型，未能充分处理多种耦合扰动。为解决该问题，本文提出Sparse2comm——一个带宽高效且鲁棒的协同三维目标检测框架，将不可靠协作视为对退化协作特征的渐进式恢复过程。稀疏特征编码首先将通信过程编码为协作智能体传输的随机掩码采样前景特征，自车基于这些特征重建稠密语义表示。该稀疏到稠密机制能够从稀疏观测中学习推断缺失的目标中心内容，从而在同一表示中实现超低带宽通信与数据包丢失恢复。在语义恢复的特征基础上，延迟感知对齐模块预测运动流以补偿延迟消息，自校准融合模块在自适应跨智能体融合前以自监督方式估计残差空间偏移。因此，Sparse2comm以有序流程恢复语义完整性、时间一致性与空间对齐性。在DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V和V2V4Real上的大量实验表明，Sparse2comm在保持具有竞争力的干净场景精度的同时，在个体及混合真实退化条件下持续提升鲁棒性。与选择性特征通信基线Where2comm相比，Sparse2comm在三个数据集上的混合场景AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别提升了+20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07和+15.36/+12.61。

Authors: Lei Yang, Boqi Li, Chunmian Lin, Li Wang, Ziying Song, Shaoqing Xu, Heye Huang, Haibao Yu, Chen Lv

Digital Twin-Driven Real2Sim2Real: Simulator-Conditioned Generation via Paired Driving-Scene Reconstruction AutonomousDriving

digital twin Real2Sim2Real generative augmentation 3D detection diffusion model

简要说明：本文提出了一种数字孪生驱动的Real2Sim2Real流程，在仿真器中重建真实驾驶片段以条件扩散模型，生成具有免费标注的照片级逼真训练图像，可大幅替代真实目标区域数据用于3D检测。

TLDR: This paper proposes a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline that reconstructs real driving clips in a simulator to condition a diffusion model, generating photorealistic training images with free annotations that can substantially substitute for real target-region data in 3D detection.

Abstract: Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving relies heavily on large annotated datasets, and deploying such a system to a new target region typically requires data collection and annotation. Generative augmentation has been proposed to reduce this cost, but existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: label-conditioned methods consume the very annotations they aim to replace, while simulator-conditioned methods offer free annotations but lack visual grounding to specific real environments. This work investigates the extent to which a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline (DT-R2S2R) can substitute for target-region real data. By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R). As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage. The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training. Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle. Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception.

摘要（中文）：基于摄像头的自动驾驶三维感知技术高度依赖大规模标注数据集，而将此类系统部署至新目标区域通常需要进行数据采集与标注。生成式增强方法已被提出以降低这一成本，但现有方法面临一个根本性权衡：基于标签条件的方法消耗的正是其试图替代的标注数据，而基于仿真器条件的方法虽然能提供免费标注，却缺乏对特定真实环境的视觉锚定。本研究探讨了数字孪生驱动的Real2Sim2Real流水线（DT-R2S2R）在何种程度上能够替代目标区域的真实数据。通过在地理参考数字孪生（DT-R2S）中重建录制的驾驶片段，我们以几何对齐的仿真渲染图作为扩散模型的条件输入，构建了数字孪生锚定的Sim2Real模型（DT-S2R）。由此，DT-S2R能够基于低成本但具备地理参考的仿真数据，在数字孪生覆盖范围内重建场景及新型仿真场景中合成逼真的驾驶图像。生成数据的有效性在多种三维检测器上得到验证。其中，DETR3D在未使用目标区域图像进行检测器训练的情况下，达到了目标区域真实数据基准（oracle）所获mAP的93.18%。此外，与现有目标外真实数据的简单协同训练甚至超越了该基准。因此，DT-R2S2R能够在数字孪生可用区域大幅降低现场人工数据采集与标注的成本，为扩展三维感知能力提供了实用基础。

Authors: Hojun Lim, Hyeongseok Jeon, Donghyun Kim, Soonyoung Jung, Heecheol Yoo

LBA-CBF: Rapidly Adaptive Safety Filters via Parallel Dynamics Inference Other

control barrier functions adaptive safety dynamics inference quadrotor autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了回看自适应控制屏障函数（LBA-CBF），通过基于近期预测误差对候选动力学模型进行排序，在不连续参数估计的情况下适应突变的动力学变化，确保安全性。在四旋翼和汽车的仿真及真实实验中展示了快速适应和鲁棒安全性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions (LBA-CBF), a safety filter that adapts to abrupt dynamics changes by ranking a bank of candidate dynamics models based on recent prediction error, ensuring safety without continuous parameter estimation. It demonstrates rapid adaptation and robust safety in quadrotor and car simulations and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Control barrier functions (CBFs) certify commands through an assumed dynamics model, so an abrupt, unmeasured regime change can undermine the certificate exactly when safety matters most. We present Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions (LBA-CBF), which rank a finite bank of candidate dynamics by recent prediction error over a short look-back window and enforce the high-order CBF condition against every model within a tolerance of the best, spanning best-fit adaptation to full-bank robust filtering. The dynamics may depend nonlinearly on the unknown parameters, and no switching model or continuously parameterized estimator is required. We prove that any feasible filtered input satisfies the true CBF condition whenever a safety-representative candidate is retained. In quadrotor simulation with abrupt wind reversals and an unknown payload, LBA-CBF is safe and reaches the goal from all random initial conditions, matching an oracle, while adaptive and robust baselines achieve 0-88% success. Banks of up to 250,000 models run inside the control loop, and Crazyflie 2.1 and F1TENTH experiments demonstrate adaptation to wind, payload release, and varying tire-road friction. Code, videos, and project details are available at: https://lla-control.github.io

摘要（中文）：控制障碍函数（CBFs）通过假设的动力学模型对命令进行认证，因此当安全性最为关键时，突发的、未测量的工况变化可能恰好破坏该认证。我们提出了回视自适应控制障碍函数（LBA-CBF），该方法通过短回视窗口内的近期预测误差对有限候选动力学模型库进行排序，并在最优模型的容差范围内对每个模型强制执行高阶CBF条件，从而涵盖从最佳拟合自适应到全库鲁棒滤波的多种策略。动力学可对未知参数呈非线性依赖，且无需切换模型或连续参数化估计器。我们证明了只要保留一个能代表安全性的候选模型，任何可行的滤波输入均满足真实CBF条件。在存在突发反向风和未知载荷的四旋翼仿真中，LBA-CBF在所有随机初始条件下均能保持安全并到达目标，与理想先知性能相当，而自适应和鲁棒基线方法的成功率仅为0-88%。控制回路内可运行多达250,000个模型的模型库，Crazyflie 2.1和F1TENTH实验验证了其对风扰、载荷释放和变化的路面轮胎摩擦力的自适应能力。代码、视频及项目详情见：https://lla-control.github.io

Authors: Maitham F. AL-Sunni, Timeea-Andreea Radu, Hassan Almubarak, Henry Z. Liao, Michael Görner, Francesco Maurelli, John M. Dolan

VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning AutonomousDriving

self-improvement embodied reasoning verification human-guided calibration driving

简要说明：VeriFine提出一种协同演进框架，通过人类引导的规则校准，实现策略、训练课程和评判器的共同改进，从而在驾驶和机器人导航任务中实现持续自我提升。

TLDR: VeriFine introduces a co-evolution framework where policy, training curriculum, and judge are jointly improved, using human-guided rubric calibration to scale verification for embodied reasoning, enabling continuous self-improvement in driving and robot navigation tasks.

Abstract: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.

摘要（中文）：自我改进的策略会持续暴露出新的失败模式，从而改变其评判者所必须能够验证的内容。然而，当前固定的评判者既限制了优化反馈，也限制了有用训练样本的发现，进而制约了进一步的自我改进。这一挑战在具身推理中尤为突出，因为在此类场景中，可靠的评估必须兼顾空间锚定、因果推理以及安全感知的决策能力。我们提出了VeriFine，一个代理框架，通过策略、训练课程与评判者的协同演化来扩展验证能力。策略改进循环利用标准评判者诊断反复出现的失败，构建自适应课程，并优化策略。当进展趋于平稳且验证成为瓶颈时，评判者改进循环会针对信息量丰富的失败案例有选择地征询人类指导，并通过共同校准来优化评判者——在此过程中，人类与代理化解分歧，逐步收敛到物理推理的客观标准。修订后的评判者随后指导下一阶段的数据筛选与策略优化。在驾驶与机器人导航任务上的实验表明，在强化学习与监督微调过程中，策略与评判者能力均实现了持续自我改进。这些结果展示了，在策略失败模式演化之际，扩展验证如何支撑持续的自我改进。

Authors: Zewei Zhou, Rachel Luo, Yulong Cao, Chaowei Xiao, Chensheng Peng, Boyi Li, Thomas Tian, Zheng Lian, Yan Wang, Jiaqi Ma, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone, Wenhao Ding

Fast Non-Parametric Heteroscedastic Imitation Learning With Geometric Priors Manipulation

Imitation Learning Geometric Priors Heteroscedastic Uncertainty Kernel Methods Real Robot Manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种利用几何先验和异方差不确定性的快速非参数模仿学习方法，用于概率策略学习，支持快速适应并在自主和共享控制场景中实现真实机器人操作。

TLDR: This paper introduces a fast non-parametric imitation learning method that leverages geometric priors and heteroscedastic uncertainty for probabilistic policy learning, enabling quick adaptation and real robot manipulation in both autonomous and shared control settings.

Abstract: When learning probabilistic policies from human demonstrations, data-efficient learning and fast adaptations to new scenarios are key requirements. One popular way to achieve intuitive and reliable adaptations is through non-parametric, typically kernel-based, methods. However, existing solutions either fail to account for the geometry of manifolds common in robotics, limiting data efficiency, or, when geometry-aware, provide unreliable uncertainty estimates or require retraining to adapt. We propose a non-parametric approach leveraging geometric priors in scenarios of data scarcity and heteroscedastic uncertainties for probabilistic modeling. We utilize the method to formulate policies based on time or robot state, where non-separable diagonal kernels allow capturing uncertainty relations between degrees of freedom for same-sized in- and outputs. Fast updates, requiring less than 3 ms for a trajectory involving both position and orientation are possible through an optimized formulation. Our approach supports both manifold-valued input and manifold-valued output with large orientation changes. Using task parameterization, adaptation to different object poses is easily possible. We evaluate the approach on a set of toy examples and on real robot manipulation tasks both in autonomous execution and in shared control scenarios.

摘要（中文）：从人类示范中学习概率策略时，数据高效的学习以及对新场景的快速适应是关键需求。实现直观且可靠适应的一种常用方法是通过非参数方法，尤其是基于核的方法。然而，现有解决方案要么未考虑机器人学中常见的流形几何结构，从而限制了数据效率；要么在考虑几何结构时，提供的不确定性估计不可靠，或需要重新训练才能适应。我们提出了一种非参数方法，在数据稀缺和异方差不确定性的场景中，利用几何先验进行概率建模。我们利用该方法，基于时间或机器人状态来制定策略，其中不可分离的对角核能够捕获同维度输入和输出之间自由度间的不确定性关系。通过优化的公式，可以实现快速更新，对于包含位置和方向的轨迹，更新耗时不到3毫秒。我们的方法支持流形值输入和流形值输出，并能处理大角度变化。利用任务参数化，可以轻松适应不同的物体姿态。我们在若干玩具示例以及真实机器人操作任务中，分别于自主执行和共享控制场景下，对该方法进行了评估。

Authors: Maximilian Mühlbauer, Arne Sachtler, Markus Knauer, Cem Küçükgenç, Yanlong Huang, Alin Albu-Schäffer, João Silvério

HygieneRoboBench: Benchmarking Hygiene-Aware Planning for Household Robots Manipulation

hygiene-aware planning household robots LLM-based planning CP-SAT contact-history reconstruction

简要说明：本文提出了 HygieneRoboBench，一个用于评估家用机器人在卫生意识任务规划能力的基准，并提出了 Hygiene-NSP，该方法结合 LLM 接地与 CP-SAT 以实现安全且符合用户优先级的低成本规划。

TLDR: This paper introduces HygieneRoboBench, a benchmark for evaluating household robot planners on hygiene-aware task planning, and proposes Hygiene-NSP, a method combining LLM grounding with CP-SAT to achieve safe and cost-efficient plans under user priorities.

Abstract: Contact with contaminated objects can spread hazards through a household robot's grippers, tools, and shared surfaces, while new contacts can make an existing plan unsafe. Existing benchmarks do not jointly assess how planners identify hygiene risks from contact history and plan safe continuations after new contact events. Planners must do so within time and resource limits while respecting user priorities. We introduce HygieneRoboBench, with 624 instances across 134 task families, to evaluate safe resolution of household tasks from a given execution history. Tasks capture contamination through two grippers and shared objects, treatment costs, and user priorities. We combine controlled history, profile, and event comparisons with independent plan evaluation. These assess safe resolution, cost efficiency under user priorities, and responses to contact events. Evaluation of LLM-based and symbolic planners shows that safely completing a task does not guarantee the lowest execution costs under the user's priorities. To address this problem, we introduce Hygiene-NSP. It combines LLM-based grounding, contact-history reconstruction, and CP-SAT to jointly plan hygiene treatment and task execution under user priorities. Hygiene-NSP achieves safe resolution and optimal safe resolution rates of 94.4% and 90.4%, respectively. Both rates are higher than those of the evaluated baseline planners on the full dataset. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/HygieneRoboBench/.

摘要（中文）：接触受污染的物体可能通过家用机器人的抓爪、工具及共享表面传播危害，而新的接触更可能使既有计划不再安全。现有基准测试并未联合评估规划者如何从接触历史中识别卫生风险，以及如何在新的接触事件发生后规划安全延续方案。规划者必须在时间和资源限制内做到这一点，同时尊重用户优先级。为此，我们提出HygieneRoboBench，包含134个任务族、共624个实例，用于评估在给定执行历史条件下安全解决家务任务的能力。任务通过两个抓爪和共享物体模拟污染传播、处理成本及用户优先级。我们结合受控的历史、配置和事件比较，并辅以独立计划评估，以衡量安全解决能力、用户优先级下的成本效益，以及对接触事件的响应情况。对基于大语言模型（LLM）和符号规划器的评估显示，安全完成任务并不能保证在用户优先级下实现最低执行成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出Hygiene-NSP方法。该方法结合基于LLM的语义理解、接触历史重构以及CP-SAT求解器，在用户优先级下联合规划卫生处理与任务执行。Hygiene-NSP的安全解决率与最优安全解决率分别为94.4%和90.4%，均高于在完整数据集上评估的所有基线规划器。项目主页：https://euron-zc.github.io/HygieneRoboBench/。

Authors: Yurun Chen, Josh Qixuan Sun, Jason Qin, Chengtai Li, Tianyi Wang, Mark Crowley, Wentao Zhu

Feeling Through the Load: Compliant Quadruped Locomotion under Payload Interactions Locomotion

force-aware locomotion compliant control causal force estimation payload interactions quadruped robot

简要说明：本文提出一种力感知运动框架，使四足机器人在携带非约束载荷时，通过学习的策略和因果力估计器，实现对人类交互的柔顺响应。

TLDR: This paper presents a force-aware locomotion framework for quadruped robots carrying unrestrained payloads, enabling compliant responses to human interactions via a learned policy and causal force estimator trained with estimator-in-the-loop data aggregation.

Abstract: Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to carry objects while moving through human environments. But what happens when a person interacts directly with the payload rather than with the robot? If the payload is unrestrained, the robot must distinguish intentional external interactions from ordinary payload motion, while still keeping the load balanced and maintaining stable locomotion. How can a quadruped infer and compliantly respond to such interactions using only onboard measurements? In this work, we develop a force-aware locomotion framework that treats payload interactions as commands that shape the motion of the combined robot-payload system. Our approach separates the learning of force-aware locomotion and force estimation on an unrestrained payload. We combine a compliant load-carrying policy with a causal force estimator, trained through estimator-in-the-loop data aggregation and finetuning, to predict interactions from onboard robot measurements. Our simulations and real-world experiments show that the resulting controller can maintain stable payload-carrying locomotion, yield compliantly to external interactions, and use the inferred force to support human-guided changes in the robot's trajectory.

摘要（中文）：四足机器人在人类环境中移动时携带物体的需求日益增长。然而，当人员直接与负载交互而非与机器人交互时，会发生什么情况？若负载不受约束，机器人必须区分有意的外部交互与常规的负载运动，同时仍需保持负载平衡并维持稳定行走。四足机器人如何仅利用机载测量来推断此类交互并作出顺应性响应？在本工作中，我们开发了一个力感知运动框架，将负载交互视为塑造机器人-负载组合系统运动的指令。我们的方法将力感知运动的学习与不受约束负载上的力估计分开处理。我们将顺应性负载携带策略与因果力估计器相结合，通过估计器在环数据聚合和微调进行训练，以从机载机器人测量中预测交互。我们的仿真和实际实验表明，所得到的控制器能够维持稳定的负载携带运动，对外部交互作出顺应性响应，并利用推断出的力支持人类引导的机器人轨迹变化。

Authors: Shaunak A. Mehta, Mayank Mishra, Prajit KrisshnaKumar, Sebastian Scherer, Koichiro Niinuma

Demo: Closed-Loop Sionna-Isaac Sim Co-Simulation Framework for Wireless-Aware Robot Navigation over ROS 2 RLRobot

co-simulation wireless-aware navigation ray tracing ROS 2 Nova Carter

简要说明：本文提出了一个基于ROS 2的NVIDIA Isaac Sim与Sionna实时协同仿真框架，用于无线感知的机器人导航，并展示了闭环规划器能以较小的额外时间消除通信中断。

TLDR: This paper presents a real-time co-simulation framework coupling NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Sionna over ROS 2 to enable wireless-aware robot navigation, demonstrating that a closed-loop planner can eliminate communication outages with minimal traversal time overhead.

Abstract: A robot that offloads its control loop to the network carries the receiver with it, so link quality is decided by where it goes. Simulating this requires both a physics engine and a site-specific propagation model at once; to our knowledge no simulator natively unifies both, with existing couplings of the two limited to offline analyses. We demonstrate a real-time co-simulation framework coupling NVIDIA Isaac Sim and NVIDIA Sionna over ROS 2 that closes the perception-action-communication (PAC) loop between them. Sionna ray-traces the base-station-to-robot channel over the exact geometry Isaac Sim simulates on, rather than modeling it stochastically, and feeds channel states back into the control loop in real time. Ray-traced on GPU, the coverage map is refreshed in ~16ms (~60 Hz), fast enough for real-time control. To showcase the framework's utility, we implement a wireless-aware navigation application in an OpenStreetMap(OSM)-derived SUTD campus twin with two Nova Carter robots: the closed-loop planner eliminates communication outage at only +7.4% traversal time over the shortest-path baseline (which spends 7.9 s of its 81.2 s run disconnected).

摘要（中文）：将控制回路卸载到网络上的机器人会随身携带接收器，因此链路质量取决于其行进位置。对此进行仿真需要同时具备物理引擎和针对特定地点的传播模型；据我们所知，尚无仿真器能够原生统一这两者，现有的耦合方式仅限于离线分析。我们展示了一个实时协同仿真框架，该框架通过ROS 2将NVIDIA Isaac Sim与NVIDIA Sionna耦合，从而在两者之间闭合感知-动作-通信（PAC）回路。Sionna基于Isaac Sim所仿真的精确几何结构，对基站到机器人的信道进行光线追踪，而非采用随机建模方式，并实时将信道状态反馈至控制回路。由于在GPU上进行光线追踪，覆盖图以约16毫秒（约60赫兹）的频率刷新，足以满足实时控制需求。为展示该框架的实用性，我们在一个基于OpenStreetMap（OSM）构建的SUTD校园数字孪生环境中，使用两台Nova Carter机器人实现了一种无线感知导航应用：闭环规划器仅以比最短路径基线多7.4%的行进时间（基线在81.2秒的运行中有7.9秒处于断连状态）即可消除通信中断。

Authors: Yi Shen Lim, Seungeun Oh, Jihong Park

Micro Neural Policies for Safe Real-Time Robotic Control RLRobot

Micro Neural Policies Evolution Strategy Statistical Model Checking Sim-to-Real Transfer Real-time Control

简要说明：本文提出微神经策略（MNP），通过进化策略和统计模型检验合成微型神经网络，实现在资源受限嵌入式设备上的安全实时控制，并在Cartpole和四旋翼任务中成功进行仿真到实物的零样本迁移。

TLDR: The paper introduces Micro Neural Policies (MNP), tiny neural networks synthesized via Evolution Strategy and verified with Statistical Model Checking, enabling safe real-time control on resource-constrained embedded devices with successful sim-to-real transfer on Cartpole and Quadrotor tasks.

Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the synthesis of Micro Neural Policies (MNP) to enable safe and robust real-time robotic control on computationally constrained embedded devices. We demonstrate that integrating Evolution Strategy (ES) and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification for policy search can drastically reduce neural network size without compromising safety and robustness. We conduct a large-scale training and evaluation of MNP on Cartpole and Quadrotor control tasks, varying control frequencies and network architectures. After validating these policies in simulation, we evaluate their deployability through zero-shot transfer to physical systems. Our experiments show that MNP can successfully achieve safe sim-to-real transfer without sacrificing control performance. We then show that the policies' memory footprint, ranging from 0.5 to 7.5 kB, allows deployment on microcontrollers, where they achieve real-time inference latency with under 25 ns of jitter while leaving the chip idle for over 97% of the time for additional workloads. This makes them a highly practical solution for severely resource-constrained robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了微型神经策略（MNP）的合成方法，以实现在计算资源受限的嵌入式设备上进行安全且鲁棒的实时机器人控制。我们证明了将进化策略（ES）与基于统计模型检验（SMC）的验证相结合用于策略搜索，能够在不牺牲安全性和鲁棒性的前提下，大幅减小神经网络规模。我们在Cartpole和Quadrotor控制任务上进行了大规模的训练与评估，并变化了控制频率和网络架构。在仿真环境中验证这些策略后，我们通过零样本迁移到物理系统来评估其可部署性。实验结果表明，MNP能够在不牺牲控制性能的情况下成功实现安全的仿真到现实迁移。随后，我们展示了这些策略的内存占用范围仅为0.5至7.5 kB，使其可部署于微控制器上，并实现低于25纳秒抖动下的实时推理延迟，同时芯片在超过97%的时间内保持空闲，以便处理额外工作负载。这使得MNP成为严重资源受限机器人系统中高度实用的解决方案。

Authors: Hongpeng Cao, Riccardo Curcio, Daniele Ottaviano, Marco Caccamo

Behavioral Safety Assessment towards Large-scale Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles, Part I: Methodology AutonomousDriving

behavioral safety autonomous vehicles safety assessment framework Behavioral Competency Test Driving Intelligence Test

简要说明：本文提出向自动驾驶汽车行为安全性的范式转变，引入了一个第三方AV安全评估框架，包含行为能力测试和驾驶智能测试两个互补的评估组件，以在大规模部署前系统评估AV在交通环境中的响应和交互。

TLDR: This paper proposes a paradigm shift toward behavioral safety for autonomous vehicles, introducing a third-party AV safety assessment framework with two complementary evaluation components: the Behavioral Competency Test and the Driving Intelligence Test, to systematically assess AV responses and interactions within traffic environments before large-scale deployment.

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) have significantly advanced in real-world deployment in recent years, yet safety continues to be a critical barrier to widespread adoption. Traditional functional safety approaches, which primarily verify the reliability, robustness, and adequacy of AV hardware and software systems from a vehicle-centric perspective, do not sufficiently address the AV's broader interactions and behavioral impact on the surrounding traffic environment. To overcome this limitation, we propose a paradigm shift toward behavioral safety, a comprehensive approach focused on evaluating AV responses and interactions within the traffic environment. To systematically assess behavioral safety, we introduce a third-party AV safety assessment framework comprising two complementary evaluation components: the Behavioral Competency Test and the Driving Intelligence Test. The Behavioral Competency Test evaluates the AV's reactive behaviors under controlled scenarios, ensuring basic behavioral competency. In contrast, the Driving Intelligence Test assesses the AV's interactive behaviors within naturalistic traffic conditions, quantifying the frequency of safety-critical events to deliver statistically meaningful safety metrics before large-scale deployment. In Part II of this study, an open-source Level 4 Automated Driving System (ADS) is tested to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶汽车近年来在实际部署方面取得了显著进展，但安全性仍然是其广泛普及的关键障碍。传统的功能安全方法主要从车辆自身的视角验证自动驾驶汽车硬件和软件系统的可靠性、鲁棒性和充分性，却未充分考量自动驾驶汽车与周围交通环境的更广泛交互及其行为影响。为克服这一局限，我们提出向行为安全范式的转变，这是一种综合方法，专注于评估自动驾驶汽车在交通环境中的响应与交互表现。为系统性地评估行为安全，我们引入了一个第三方自动驾驶汽车安全评估框架，包含两个互补的评估组件：行为能力测试和驾驶智能测试。行为能力测试在受控场景下评估自动驾驶汽车的响应行为，确保其具备基本的行为能力。相比之下，驾驶智能测试在自然交通条件下评估自动驾驶汽车的交互行为，量化安全关键事件的频率，以在大规模部署前提供具有统计意义的安全指标。在本研究的第二部分中，我们对一个开源的四级自动驾驶系统进行了测试，以验证所提方法的有效性。

Authors: Henry X. Liu, Tinghan Wang, Xintao Yan, Haowei Sun, Zhijie Qiao, Kenneth Boyd, Shuo Feng, Greg Stevens, Greg McGuire

Post-Grasp Kinematic Repair for Robotic Insertion via Object-in-Gripper Reorientation Manipulation

post-grasp reorientation kinematic feasibility IK graph tactile-based manipulation robotic insertion

简要说明：本文通过抓取后重新定向夹爪中的物体来解决机器人插入任务中的运动学不可行性问题，利用分支感知的IK图和学习的先验提高搜索效率，并在仿真和真实UR5e机器人上验证。

TLDR: The paper addresses kinematic infeasibility in robotic insertion by reorienting the object in the gripper post-grasp, using a branch-aware IK graph and a learned prior for efficient search, validated in simulation and on a real UR5e robot.

Abstract: A stable grasp does not guarantee kinematically feasible robotic insertion because the object-in-gripper transform may force the robot towards singularities or joint limits along the prescribed insertion path. We study post-grasp kinematic feasibility repair through object-in-gripper reorientation. Given an achieved grasp and a fixed insertion path, we seek a small reorientation that restores kinematic feasibility. Sequential IK can miss such candidates by following an unfavorable joint-space path, while the nonsmooth feasibility landscape makes the search computationally expensive. We evaluate candidates using a branch-aware IK graph that maximizes the minimum feasibility margin over the discretized insertion path and use a learned task-conditioned prior to improve query ordering. The selected reorientation is executed through tactile-based extrinsic manipulation. In UR5e simulations, the planner without learned ranking reduces mean reorientation over successful trials by 51.5% compared with grid-based sequential IK. Adding learned ranking reduces this planner's mean planning time by an additional 51.1%. Real-robot experiments validate the complete pipeline.

摘要（中文）：稳定的抓取并不能保证机器人插入在运动学上可行，因为夹爪内物体的位姿变换可能使机器人沿预设插入路径趋向奇异点或关节极限。我们研究通过夹爪内物体重定向来修复抓取后运动学可行性的问题。给定一个已实现的抓取和一条固定的插入路径，我们寻求一个小的重定向以恢复运动学可行性。顺序逆运动学（IK）可能因沿不利的关节空间路径而遗漏此类候选方案，而非光滑的可行性景观使搜索计算成本高昂。我们使用分支感知的IK图来评估候选方案，该图在离散化的插入路径上最大化最小可行性裕度，并利用学习到的任务条件先验来改进查询排序。选定的重定向通过基于触觉的外部操作执行。在UR5e仿真中，与基于网格的顺序IK相比，无学习排序的规划器在成功试验中将平均重定向量减少了51.5%。加入学习排序后，该规划器的平均规划时间进一步减少了51.1%。真实机器人实验验证了完整流程的有效性。

Authors: Haegu Lee, Christoffer Sloth

Sensor-Layout-Agnostic Navigation via Geometric Observation Canonicalization RLRobot

sensor-layout-agnostic spherical range image zero-shot generalization navigation policy reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出一种面向空中平台的具身感知导航策略，通过将深度测量反投影到统一的机器人中心球面距离图像并附带有效性掩码，实现对不同深度传感器布局的零样本泛化，并在仿真和真实飞行中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an embodiment-informed navigation policy for aerial platforms that generalizes zero-shot across diverse depth sensor layouts by unprojecting depth measurements into a shared robot-centric spherical range image with a validity mask, validated in simulation and real-world flights.

Abstract: Existing visual navigation policies are inherently bound to fixed camera configurations, creating a fundamental barrier to zero-shot deployment across heterogeneous robot sensor layouts. To overcome this limitation, we present an embodiment-informed navigation policy capable of generalizing across diverse depth sensor configurations on a specific aerial platform. Instead of implicitly learning spatial alignments, our approach explicitly unprojects depth measurements from arbitrary depth sensor payloads, varying in sensor count, mounting extrinsics, and intrinsics, into a shared robot-centric frame, stitching them into a unified spherical range image and a binary validity mask. This mask allows the downstream policy to explicitly distinguish covered space from unobserved blind spots. Trained via reinforcement learning with aggressive camera randomization, our policy generalizes zero-shot to unseen layouts featuring up to seven cameras, scaling success rates from 78% to 95% as total spatial sensing coverage increases. Finally, real-world flight trials on a physical quadrotor, conducted in an obstacle-filled corridor and an outdoor forest, validate the policy's zero-shot transfer across camera configurations and its resilience to sudden online sensor dropouts.

摘要（中文）：现有的视觉导航策略本质上依赖于固定的相机配置，这为在异构机器人传感器布局上的零样本部署设置了根本性障碍。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一种具身感知的导航策略，能够在特定空中平台上泛化至多种深度传感器配置。我们的方法并非隐式学习空间对齐，而是显式地将来自任意深度传感器载荷（其数量、安装外参及内参均存在差异）的深度测量反投影至共享的机器人中心坐标系，并将其拼接为统一的球形距离图像及二值有效掩码。该掩码使下游策略能够明确区分已覆盖空间与未观测盲区。通过结合激进相机随机化的强化学习训练，我们的策略可零样本泛化至包含多达七个相机的未见布局，随着总空间感知覆盖范围增大，成功率从78%提升至95%。最后，在物理四旋翼平台上，于布满障碍物的走廊及户外森林中开展的真实飞行试验，验证了该策略在不同相机配置间的零样本迁移能力，及其对在线传感器突然缺失的鲁棒性。

Authors: Welf Rehberg, Kostas Alexis

UWB Meets Crazyflow: Simulating Degraded Feedback at Scale for Aerial Robotics Other

differentiable simulation JAX aerial robotics UWB/IMU reinforcement learning

简要说明：Crazyflow 是一个基于 JAX 的用于空中机器人的可微分仿真器，加速了强化学习训练，并集成了 UWB/IMU 传感器仿真和 EKF，用于在退化状态反馈下进行大规模控制器评估。

TLDR: Crazyflow is a JAX-based differentiable simulator for aerial robotics that accelerates RL training and integrates UWB/IMU sensor simulation with an EKF for evaluating controllers under degraded state feedback at scale.

Abstract: In this work, we introduce Crazyflow, an accurate, differentiable simulator built on JAX. By leveraging jit compilation via XLA, Crazyflow unifies physics and control into a single differentiable computation graph, enabling massive parallelization on accelerated hardware without sacrificing modeling accuracy. This architecture achieves order-of-magnitude speedups over existing baselines, capable of training deployable reinforcement learning agents in seconds. To highlight its highly modular design, we demonstrate how easily Crazyflow can be extended by integrating a complete, high-fidelity Ultra-Wideband (UWB) and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) simulation pipeline coupled with a full-state Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). This capability allows for massive parallel controller evaluation under realistic, degraded state feedback with minimal impact on GPU throughput. By combining speed, accuracy, and extensibility, Crazyflow serves as a foundational tool for the next generation of aerial robotics research.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了Crazyflow，一个基于JAX构建的精确可微分仿真器。通过利用XLA的即时编译技术，Crazyflow将物理与控制统一到单一的可微分计算图中，在保持建模精度的同时，实现了加速硬件上的大规模并行化。该架构相较于现有基线实现了数量级的加速，能够在数秒内训练出可部署的强化学习智能体。为突出其高度模块化的设计，我们展示了如何通过集成完整的、高保真超宽带（UWB）与惯性测量单元（IMU）仿真管线，并耦合全状态扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF），轻松扩展Crazyflow。该功能允许在逼真且退化的状态反馈条件下进行大规模并行控制器评估，且对GPU吞吐量影响极小。通过将速度、精度与可扩展性相结合，Crazyflow为下一代空中机器人研究奠定了坚实基础。
