Authors: Martin Schuck, Marcel P. Rath, Yufei Hua, Abhishek Goudar, SiQi Zhou, Angela P. Schoellig

Context-Conditioned Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Adaptive Safety Filtering AutonomousDriving

Hamilton-Jacobi reachability safety filtering control barrier function autonomous racing context-conditioned

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性的上下文条件安全证书，通过将安全证书关联到边界几何、摩擦系数等上下文变量，实现了对未见几何和条件的泛化，并在全尺寸自动驾驶车辆上验证了其安全性和性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Hamilton-Jacobi reachability framework that conditions a single safety certificate on context variables (boundary geometry, friction, disturbance), enabling transfer to unseen geometries and conditions. It validates the approach on a full-scale autonomous vehicle, showing safety with modest performance cost.

Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi reachability constructs safety certificates for specified dynamics and safety constraints, tying each certificate to the deployment context for which it is synthesized. We ask whether a single certificate can instead represent a family of context-dependent safety problems and be queried across deployment conditions without re-synthesis. We learn a backward reachable tube for an eight-state vehicle model conditioned on local boundary geometry, friction coefficient, and adversarial disturbance scale. Geometry enters through an ego-frame boundary observation that defines the local containment constraint, while friction and disturbance scale enter as explicit operating-condition variables. This allows the same value function to be queried across friction coefficients from 0.4 to 2.0 and on geometries absent from synthesis. On 11 held-out evaluation geometries, the certificate maintains containment across the full tested friction range, including simultaneous geometry and grip shifts, while remaining within 1.2 percentage points in intervention rate and 0.09 m/s in speed of certificates re-synthesized with knowledge of the test geometry. We then deploy the certificate as a sampled discrete-time control barrier function filter on a full-scale vehicle near the handling limit. Lateral containment holds in every hardware session under both adversarial driving and autonomous racing, with 99th-percentile acceleration magnitude reaching 0.99 g. Across three certificates evaluated under a fixed autonomous racing controller, lap time varies by only 3.1%, demonstrating that a context-conditioned reachability certificate can transfer to deployment geometries absent from synthesis with modest performance cost.

摘要（中文）：哈密尔顿-雅可比可达性分析为特定动力学模型和安全约束构建安全证书，使每个证书与其合成时的部署场景紧密绑定。本文探讨能否用单一证书表示一类依赖场景的安全问题，并在不同部署条件下查询而无需重新合成。我们针对一个八状态车辆模型，学习了一个以局部边界几何、摩擦系数和对抗性扰动幅度为条件信息的后向可达管。几何信息通过自车坐标系下的边界观测输入，定义了局部包围约束；摩擦系数和扰动幅度则作为显式的运行条件变量。这使得同一值函数可在摩擦系数0.4至2.0的范围内以及合成时未出现的几何场景下进行查询。在11个留出评估几何上，该证书在整个测试摩擦范围内均保持包围性质，包括几何与抓地力同时变化的情况，同时干预率与基于测试几何信息重新合成的证书相比差距在1.2个百分点以内，速度差距在0.09 m/s以内。随后，我们将该证书作为采样的离散时间控制屏障函数滤波器，部署在一辆接近操控极限的全尺寸车辆上。在对抗性驾驶和自主竞速的所有硬件测试中，横向包围约束均得到满足，99百分位加速度幅值达到0.99 g。在固定自主竞速控制器下评估的三种证书中，单圈时间差异仅为3.1%，表明场景条件化的可达性证书能够以较小的性能代价迁移至合成时未出现的部署几何场景。

Authors: Ali Fuat Sahin, Yunus Yazoglu, John Talbot, Zeyuan Feng, James Dallas, Somil Bansal

Energy-Aware Path Following: Comparative Analysis of Reinforcement Learning and NMPC for Electric Vehicles AutonomousDriving

path following reinforcement learning NMPC electric vehicles regenerative braking

简要说明：本文比较了强化学习（PPO）与NMPC控制器在电动汽车能量感知路径跟踪中的性能，并在带有再生制动的统一车辆模型下展示了可迁移性。

TLDR: This paper compares reinforcement learning (PPO) and NMPC controllers for energy-aware path following of electric vehicles, demonstrating transferable performance under a common vehicle model with regenerative braking.

Abstract: Path-following control strategies typically follow the bi-objective optimization dilemma: minimizing deviations from a reference path while maintaining smooth speed profiles. The latter objective is especially relevant for Electric Vehicles (EVs), since their limited driving range can be extended by recovering energy through regenerative braking, a feature that has not yet been sufficiently studied in the literature. In this work, we perform a comparative analysis of four controllers under one common Frenet frame-based kinematic vehicle model, utilizing a validated energy model (VT-CPEM) with explicit regenerative braking. Herein, we implement the following controllers: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), gain-scheduled Ackermann state-feedback baseline (PID-SF), and a Stanley geometric baseline. To satisfy real-time requirements, we implement the NMPC using JIT-compiled CasADi. Moreover, we train the PPO using traditional straight and S-curve tracks, after which we successfully transfer the unmodified policy to unseen tracks, including: an ISO 3888-1 lane-change, a chicane, randomly-generated parameterized-splines, and a $\pm3^\circ$ graded road. In addition, the policy transfers to a dynamic single-track vehicle model with linear tires, zero-shot with an acceptable initial performance, which was optimized after brief fine-tuning. Thereby, we demonstrate that our PPO is readily transferable to more comprehensive vehicle models. We conclude with a performance analysis of developed controllers and discuss ideas for future work.

摘要（中文）：路径跟踪控制策略通常面临双目标优化难题：在最小化参考路径偏差的同时，保持平滑的速度曲线。后一个目标对于电动汽车尤为重要，因为其有限的续航里程可以通过再生制动回收能量来延长，而这一特性在现有文献中尚未得到充分研究。在本研究中，我们在统一的基于Frenet框架的运动学车辆模型下，对四种控制器进行了比较分析，并采用了带有显式再生制动的验证能量模型（VT-CPEM）。我们实现了以下控制器：非线性模型预测控制、近端策略优化、增益调度Ackermann状态反馈基线（PID-SF）以及Stanley几何基线。为满足实时性要求，我们使用JIT编译的CasADi实现NMPC。此外，我们使用传统直线和S形弯道轨迹训练PPO，随后成功地将未修改的策略迁移到未见过的轨迹上，包括ISO 3888-1换道测试、减速弯道、随机生成的参数化样条曲线，以及坡度角为±3°的路面。同时，该策略还能零样本迁移至带线性轮胎的动态单轨车辆模型，初始性能可接受，并在短暂微调后得到优化。由此，我们证明了PPO可以便捷地迁移至更全面的车辆模型。最后，我们对所开发的控制器进行了性能分析，并讨论了未来工作的方向。

Authors: Mohamed Sabaa, Mostafa Emam

Reactive Exploration of Unknown Environments for Redundant Robots using Virtual Model Control Manipulation

active exploration redundant robots virtual model control reactive obstacle avoidance eye-in-hand camera

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对冗余机械臂的主动探索方法，利用评分方法选择目标体素，并采用虚拟模型控制实现柔顺的全身反应式避障，在实时环境中实现了高地图覆盖率。

TLDR: This paper proposes an active exploration approach for redundant robotic arms using a scoring method to select target voxels and Virtual Model Control for compliant whole-body reactive obstacle avoidance, achieving high mapping coverage in real-time.

Abstract: The exploration of confined, occluded, and partially known spaces poses significant challenges in robotic manipulation. The overall pose of the robotic arm must be carefully controlled to respect tight geometric constraints while avoiding newly discovered obstacles. We address this problem by proposing an active exploration approach for redundant robotic arms with an eye-in-hand camera configuration. Our approach navigates and acquires information in real-time based on a novel scoring method that directly selects a target voxel from the unexplored space using the robot's current state and expected information gain. To move the robot safely toward the target voxel, we utilize Virtual Model Control, which guarantees compliance and enables whole-body reactive obstacle avoidance without the need for path replanning. Simulated and real-robot experiments in both confined and open environments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving over $90\%$ mapping coverage across all tested environments in under $120$ seconds without colliding with obstacles.

摘要（中文）：探索受限、封闭及部分未知空间对机器人操控提出了重大挑战。机械臂的整体位姿必须被精细控制，以在避开新发现障碍物的同时满足严格的几何约束。针对这一问题，我们提出了一种适用于搭载手眼相机配置的冗余机械臂的主动探索方法。该方法基于一种新颖的评分机制，利用机器人当前状态和预期信息增益，直接从未探索空间中选择目标体素，从而实现实时导航与信息采集。为使机器人安全地向目标体素移动，我们采用了虚拟模型控制，该控制方法保证了柔顺性，并实现了无需路径重规划的全身体反应式避障。在受限环境与开放环境中进行的仿真及真实机器人实验均验证了该方法的有效性，在所有测试环境中，该方法均能在120秒内实现超过90%的地图覆盖率，且未与障碍物发生碰撞。

Authors: Alessio Canzolino, Omar Faris, Alessandro De Blasi, Fulvio Forni

Navigation with RF Cues: Embodied Perception Action under Multipath Uncertainty RLRobot

RF navigation multimodal navigation multipath uncertainty embodied perception Habitat Sionna RT

简要说明：本文提出用于智能工厂RF-视觉导航的Habitat Sionna RT基准，以及一种不确定性感知的多模态导航框架，融合RF、视觉和位姿历史来估计目标方向及其不确定性，在未知场景中提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Habitat Sionna RT benchmark for RF-visual navigation in smart factories and an uncertainty-aware multimodal navigation framework that fuses RF, visual, and pose history to estimate target direction and uncertainty, improving success rates in unseen scenes.

Abstract: Smart factory inspection requires robots to reach connected equipment without a prior map or known target coordinates. Radio frequency (RF) signals from the target can provide directional cues to complement visual observations when occlusion or poor lighting limits target detection. However, multipath propagation can distort these cues, making it difficult to infer the target's true direction from instantaneous RF measurements. To enable navigation research under these conditions, we first construct a Habitat Sionna RT benchmark that uses detailed scene geometry and assigned material properties to generate aligned visual and RF observations in response to robot actions. Building on this benchmark, we propose an uncertainty aware multimodal navigation framework that jointly estimates target direction and its uncertainty from a history of RF, visual, and pose observations. These estimates inform action selection alongside visual context. Experiments in unseen scenes show relative improvements of 18.2% in success rate (SR) and 11.5% in success weighted by path length (SPL) over the strongest evaluated baseline.

摘要（中文）：智能工厂巡检要求机器人在无预先地图或已知目标坐标的情况下抵达联网设备。当遮挡或光线不足限制目标检测时，来自目标的射频信号可提供方向线索，以补充视觉观测。然而，多径传播可能扭曲这些线索，使得从瞬时射频测量中推断目标的真实方向变得困难。为在此类条件下开展导航研究，我们首先构建了一个Habitat Sionna RT基准，利用详细的场景几何和指定的材料属性，根据机器人动作生成对齐的视觉和射频观测。在此基准基础上，我们提出了一种不确定性感知的多模态导航框架，该框架利用射频、视觉和位姿观测的历史数据，联合估计目标方向及其不确定性。这些估计结果与视觉上下文共同指导动作选择。在未见场景中的实验显示，与最强评估基线相比，成功率（SR）相对提高了18.2%，按路径长度加权的成功率（SPL）相对提高了11.5%。

Authors: Wenlihan Lu, Tianshun Li, Liuqing Yang, Shijian Gao

Reactive Task-Oriented Robot-Human Handovers via Generative Hypothesis Selection Manipulation

robot-human handover VLM image generation task-oriented handover hand-object interaction mobile manipulator

简要说明：本文提出GENESIS-Handover方法，利用VLM生成多样化的任务特定手-物交互假设，实时匹配人类手部姿态以完成机器人-人类交接，并在移动操作机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces GENESIS-Handover, a method that uses a VLM to generate diverse task-specific hand-object interaction hypotheses for robot-human handovers, selecting the best match to observed human hand poses in real time, and validates it on a mobile manipulator.

Abstract: When humans hand each other objects, they incorporate both geometric and semantic information into this process. For example, passing a knife with the handle towards the recipient, rather than the blade, is both more ergonomic and safer. Recent state-of-the-art methods for task-oriented robot-human handovers have progressed from modeling object geometry to incorporating object affordances. However, they often forgo predicting the explicit, task-specific hand poses a human selects to utilize an object. Since many objects support multiple interaction modalities, e.g., a claw hammer used to strike or pull nails, this variability must be modeled to achieve robust task-oriented handovers. To tackle this, we propose a novel approach, GENESIS-Handover (GENErative HypotheSIS), which leverages VLM image generation to produce a variety of task-specific hand-object interaction hypotheses. These hypotheses are matched in real time to the observed human hand pose, enabling inference of the most suitable handover configuration. By leveraging VLMs as priors of plausible hand-object interactions, the method produces task-conditioned handover strategies for previously unseen object-task pairs. We evaluate the standalone interaction proposal module before deploying the full system on a mobile manipulator. In a user study with 12 participants across five task-object pairs, 83.3% perceived our method to have better task understanding than the previous state of the art.

摘要（中文）：当人类相互传递物体时，他们会将几何信息和语义信息都融入这一过程。例如，递刀时将刀柄朝向接收者而非刀刃，既更符合人体工程学也更安全。近年来，面向任务的机器人-人类交接最先进方法已从建模物体几何形状发展到融入物体可供性。然而，这些方法往往忽略了预测人类为使用物体而选择的明确、特定任务的手部姿态。由于许多物体支持多种交互模式，例如羊角锤可用于敲击或拔钉，因此必须对这种变异性进行建模，以实现稳健的面向任务的交接。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖方法GENESIS-Handover（生成式假设），该方法利用VLM图像生成来产生多种特定任务的手-物交互假设。这些假设与实时观测到的人类手部姿态进行匹配，从而推断出最合适的交接配置。通过利用VLM作为合理手-物交互的先验知识，该方法能为先前未见过的物体-任务组合生成任务条件下的交接策略。我们首先对独立的交互提议模块进行评估，然后将完整系统部署在移动机械臂上。在一项包含12名参与者、涵盖五组任务-物体对的用户研究中，83.3%的参与者认为我们的方法在任务理解方面优于先前的最先进方法。

Authors: Carmen Scheidemann, Andreea Tulbure, Pascal Burkhardt, Marco Hutter

EmbodiedSmith: Scaling Embodied Data through Recursive Self-Improvement Flywheel in Simulation Other

recursive self-improvement simulation data generation scene-task co-refinement embodied data scaling robot pretraining

简要说明：EmbodiedSmith 提出了一种在仿真中通过递归自我改进飞轮来联合优化场景与任务生成的方法，支持多种具身形态和复杂物理，以扩展用于机器人预训练和评估的具身数据。

TLDR: EmbodiedSmith introduces a recursive self-improvement flywheel in simulation that jointly refines scene and task generation, supporting diverse embodiments and complex physics, to scale embodied data for robot pretraining and evaluation.

Abstract: Scaling robotic foundation models requires diverse training data and reliable evaluation environments. Simulation offers a scalable solution, yet existing generation pipelines remain constrained by predefined assets and skills, a disconnect between scene generation and task generation, and limited support for complex embodiments and physics. We introduce EmbodiedSmith, a framework for scalable embodied data generation through recursive self-improvement (RSI). EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene, and task generation in a pipeline that supports autonomous creation and language-driven customization. Its core is an agentic refinement loop: scene generation anticipates downstream task requirements, while task generation guides targeted scene edits, allowing scenes and tasks to iteratively improve one another. This joint refinement improves task generation success, including for long-horizon tasks. The framework further supports mobile manipulators, humanoids, and dexterous hands, as well as interactions involving deformable objects and fluids, broadening the range of behaviors and physical phenomena represented in generated data. Together, these capabilities provide a flexible simulation engine for both robot pretraining and evaluation. Extensive experiments validate the quality, diversity, and generation efficiency of the resulting data, while downstream policy experiments demonstrate that increased data diversity improves generalization.

摘要（中文）：扩展机器人基础模型需要多样化的训练数据和可靠的评估环境。仿真提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，然而现有的生成流程仍受限于预定义的资产和技能，场景生成与任务生成之间相互脱节，且对复杂具身形态和物理机制的支持有限。我们提出EmbodiedSmith，一个通过递归自我改进（RSI）实现可扩展具身数据生成的框架。EmbodiedSmith在一条统一流程中整合了资产、场景和任务生成，支持自主创建和语言驱动的定制化。其核心是一个智能体式优化循环：场景生成预判下游任务需求，而任务生成则引导针对性的场景编辑，使场景与任务能够迭代互促。这种联合优化提升了任务生成的成功率，包括长时域任务。该框架进一步支持移动操作机器人、人形机器人和灵巧手，以及涉及可变形物体和流体的交互，拓宽了生成数据中所表征的行为和物理现象的范畴。综合来看，这些能力为机器人预训练和评估提供了一套灵活的仿真引擎。大量实验验证了所生成数据的质量、多样性和生成效率，而下游策略实验则表明，数据多样性的提升有助于改善泛化能力。

Authors: Yikai Qin, Yifei Deng, Mingjian Liang, Wenxuan Song, Zepeng Lin, Zhiyi Jiang, Jiajun Fu, Qiao Sun, Huashuo Lei, Xicheng Gong, Jiayi Chen, Han Zhao, Shuanghao Bai, Pengxiang Ding, Pengwei Wang, Haoang Li

Revisiting Temporal Regularization for Smooth Control in Deep Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

temporal regularization action smoothing deep reinforcement learning smooth control physical robots

简要说明：本文重新审视了深度强化学习中用于平滑控制的时间正则化，证明其能提供空间平滑性，并提出CATS方法，结合时间惩罚与线性ramp-up，在仿真和真实实验中减少动作振荡而不损害任务性能。

TLDR: This paper revisits temporal regularization for smooth control in deep RL, proving it can provide spatial smoothness and proposing CATS, a method that combines a temporal penalty with linear ramp-up to reduce action oscillations without degrading task performance in simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning policies can produce nonsmooth action oscillations that hinder deployment on physical robots. Existing architectural and penalty-based approaches seek spatial smoothness by directly reducing sensitivity to changes in state inputs, but their broad constraints can degrade task performance as stronger smoothing is pursued. Temporal regularization instead constrains action differences along observed transitions, but has been considered unable to provide the spatial smoothness needed under observation noise. We revisit this assumption by proving that the temporal penalty bounds the expected action differences between current states sharing a next state, revealing a spatial effect that empirically extends to spatial smoothness. Building on this finding, we propose Conditioning for Action using only Temporal Smoothness (CATS), which combines a temporal penalty with linear ramp-up. We highlight temporal regularization's ability to provide spatial smoothness while better preserving task performance than explicit spatial regularization. Through linear ramp-up, CATS allows the policy to learn rewarding behavior before progressively smoothing its actions, improving return preservation and both temporal and spatial smoothness. Experiments in both simulation and the real world show that CATS substantially reduces action oscillation without degrading task performance, with little computational overhead.

摘要（中文）：深度强化学习策略可能产生非平滑的动作振荡，从而阻碍其在物理机器人上的部署。现有的基于架构和基于惩罚的方法通过直接降低对状态输入变化的敏感性来寻求空间平滑性，但其宽泛的约束在追求更强平滑性时可能损害任务性能。时间正则化则沿着观测到的转移约束动作差异，但此前被认为无法在观测噪声下提供所需的空间平滑性。我们重新审视了这一假设，通过证明时间惩罚界定了共享下一状态的当前状态之间的期望动作差异，揭示了一种在经验上可扩展至空间平滑性的空间效应。基于这一发现，我们提出了仅利用时间平滑性的动作条件化方法（CATS），该方法将时间惩罚与线性递增相结合。我们强调，时间正则化能够提供空间平滑性，同时比显式空间正则化更好地保持任务性能。通过线性递增，CATS允许策略在学习奖励性行为后再逐步平滑其动作，从而提升回报保持率以及时间与空间平滑性。在仿真和真实世界的实验中，CATS在几乎不增加计算开销的情况下，显著减少了动作振荡，且不损害任务性能。

Authors: SungJae Ahn, Jeong Woon Lee, Kyoleen Kwak, Hyoseok Hwang

Multi-Robot Multi-Goal Motion Planning with Stochastic Skills Manipulation

multi-robot planning motion planning stochastic skills reactive policy sampling-based

简要说明：本文通过将问题表述为多模态复合路线图上的MDP，将随机操作技能集成到多机器人基于采样的运动规划中，从而生成响应式策略以实现动态协调。

TLDR: This paper integrates stochastic manipulation skills into multi-robot sampling-based motion planning by formulating the problem as an MDP over a multi-modal composite roadmap, yielding reactive policies for dynamic coordination.

Abstract: As robots are increasingly deployed in groups and share workspaces to execute real-world tasks, planning their concurrent motions around complex manipulation skills becomes essential. These skills involve continuous physical execution and may exhibit stochastic behavior, resulting in variable execution times and uncertain continuous trajectories. Existing planners either limit execution to single-robot scenarios, rely on open-loop paths, or use post-hoc scheduling that prevents dynamic coordination. In this paper, we address this gap by integrating stochastic skills into sampling-based multi-robot planning by formulating the problem as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) over a multi-modal composite roadmap. For stochastic skills, solving the MDP yields a reactive policy that allows controllable robots to dynamically adapt their motions in response to other robots' execution of manipulation skills. By resolving skill uncertainty directly at planning time, this approach avoids the pessimism of conservative baselines and unlocks robust, dynamic multi-robot coordination. Code for the planners is available at https://www.vhartmann.com/stochastic-skills.

摘要（中文）：随着机器人在实际任务中被越来越多地以群体形式部署并共享工作空间，规划它们在复杂操作技能下的并发运动变得至关重要。这些技能涉及连续的物理执行过程，并可能表现出随机行为，从而导致执行时间可变且连续轨迹具有不确定性。现有规划器要么将执行限制在单机器人场景，要么依赖开环路径，要么采用事后调度方式而无法实现动态协调。在本文中，我们通过将随机技能纳入基于采样的多机器人规划中，将该问题建模为多模态复合路图上的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），从而填补了这一空白。对于随机技能，求解MDP可得到一个反应式策略，使可控机器人能够根据其他机器人操作技能的执行情况动态调整自身运动。通过在规划阶段直接消解技能不确定性，该方法避免了保守基线方法的过度悲观，并实现了鲁棒、动态的多机器人协调。规划器的代码可在 https://www.vhartmann.com/stochastic-skills 获取。

Authors: William Schnyder, Valentin N. Hartmann, Stelian Coros

From Wearable Interfaces to Dexterous Policies: Contact Shifts and Tactile Representations Manipulation

wearable interface tactile representations dexterous manipulation DexUMI exoskeleton policy learning

简要说明：本文研究了可穿戴界面几何形状对灵巧操作中演示质量和策略性能的影响，表明改进的外骨骼设计改变了触觉记录并提高了下游策略成功率。在多个任务上评估了基于二值聚合和力-空间表示训练的策略。

TLDR: This paper investigates how wearable interface geometry affects demonstration quality and policy performance in dexterous manipulation, showing that revised exoskeleton designs change tactile recordings and improve downstream policy success. It evaluates trained policies on finger-gaiting and force-spatial representations across multiple tasks.

Abstract: Unlike conventional teleoperation, wearable interfaces allow operators to collect dexterous demonstrations through their own hand motions while directly interacting with task objects. This direct interaction reduces dependence on the target robot during collection, but it also makes the collection hardware part of the physical process that generates each demonstration. Interface geometry can influence both how a task is performed and what tactile observations are recorded for learning. We study two versions of a DexUMI-family exoskeleton that share the same robot command definition, mapping procedure, and tactile module type but differ in hand-side geometry. The revised interface reduces reported physical demand, improves selected device ratings, enables tactile access in a precision grasp that is mechanically blocked by the baseline, and produces task-dependent changes in recorded contact. Lid twisting primarily exhibits a change in contact location, whereas egg carton opening primarily exhibits a change in contact occurrence. We then train matched policies using either a binary aggregate input or a spatial-plus-force input. On lid twisting and egg carton opening, policies trained on revised-interface demonstrations achieve higher success than those trained on baseline demonstrations, with a significant pooled interface effect. Across these and two additional tasks, USB insertion and soldering tool pick and place, the spatial-plus-force input likewise outperforms binary aggregation. These results show that wearable collection hardware is part of the data-generation process for robot learning. Such interfaces should therefore be evaluated not only through operator experience, but also through the tactile interactions they make recordable and the policy performance their demonstrations support.

摘要（中文）：与传统遥操作不同，可穿戴接口允许操作者通过自身手部动作收集灵巧演示，并直接与任务对象交互。这种直接交互减少了对目标机器人在采集过程中的依赖，但也使采集硬件成为生成每条演示数据的物理过程的一部分。接口的几何结构既能影响任务执行方式，也能影响为学习所记录的触觉观测数据。我们研究了DexUMI系列外骨骼的两个版本，它们共享相同的机器人指令定义、映射流程和触觉模块类型，但手部侧几何结构不同。改进后的接口降低了操作者报告的身体负担，提升了设备评分，实现了在基线版本中因机械结构限制而无法完成的精细抓取触觉采集，并在记录接触方面产生了任务依赖性变化。瓶盖扭转任务主要表现为接触位置的变化，而蛋盒开合任务主要表现为接触发生与否的变化。随后，我们分别使用二值聚合输入和空间加力输入训练相匹配的策略。在瓶盖扭转和蛋盒开合任务中，基于改进接口演示训练的策略成功率高于基于基线演示训练的策略，且合并分析显示接口效应显著。在以上两项任务及另外两项任务（USB插拔和焊锡工具取放）中，空间加力输入同样优于二值聚合输入。这些结果表明，可穿戴采集硬件是机器人学习数据生成过程的一部分。因此，此类接口的评价不仅应基于操作者体验，还应考虑其可记录的触觉交互以及其演示所支撑的策略性能。

Authors: Ruitong Tian, Fang Xu, Noah B. Wilson, Xianyao Li, Eric Jing Du

Belief-Informed Hybrid Control with Almost-Sure Target-Set Convergence Manipulation

belief-space planning dual control receding-horizon almost-sure convergence bimanual assembly

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于信念的双重控制算法，用于参数不确定下的混合系统，证明了几乎必然的靶集收敛性，并在双臂装配任务中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a belief-informed dual-control algorithm for hybrid systems under parameter uncertainty, proving almost-sure target-set convergence and demonstrating it on a bimanual assembly task.

Abstract: Controlling a hybrid system to a target set under parameter uncertainty can require informative actions that temporarily drive the system state away from the specified set. We propose a belief-informed dual-control algorithm that combines belief-space receding-horizon selection with an expected-decrease constraint on a nonnegative target-set progress function. To accommodate exploratory deviations, a scalar controller state bounds the constraint's cumulative slack. Our algorithm's two-step lookahead selection uses predicted observations to update the parameter belief before evaluating the subsequent action's admissibility. Under distance-comparison bounds, correct conditional prediction, and recursive feasibility, we prove almost-sure target-set convergence at decision times and bound both the sum of expected progress-function values and the expected neighborhood-entry time. Upper confidence bounds extend these convergence guarantees to bounded model samples with summable error probabilities. In planar regulation with an unknown control direction, we verify recursive feasibility: the proposed two-step selection reduces the Euclidean state norm below 0.01 within 11 decisions for either sign, whereas a myopic one-step selection loses admissibility immediately after zero input. In a simulated bimanual assembly task, our algorithm's one-step implementation uses clearance feedback to complete the assembly under nominal friction, yielding a 96.4% lower infinity-norm relative-position error than the reference-tracking baseline at the method's completion time. At lower friction, its posterior conditioning successfully detects an empty admissible set, whereas a fixed-prior alternative admits an action that violates the conditional decrease constraint. Project page: https://clintonenwerem.com/belief-hybrid-control/.

摘要（中文）：在参数不确定条件下，将混合系统控制至目标集合可能需要采取信息丰富的动作，这些动作会暂时使系统状态偏离指定集合。我们提出了一种基于信念的对偶控制算法，该算法将信念空间滚动时域选择与非负目标集合进展函数的期望递减约束相结合。为容纳探索性偏差，一个标量控制器状态对约束的累积松弛量进行限定。我们算法的两步前瞻选择利用预测观测值在评估后续动作可行性之前更新参数信念。在距离比较界、条件预测正确性及递归可行性的条件下，我们证明了决策时刻的几乎必然目标集合收敛性，并界定了期望进展函数值之和及期望邻域进入时间。上置信界将这些收敛保证扩展到具有可加和误差概率的有界模型样本。在控制方向未知的平面调节问题中，我们验证了递归可行性：所提出的两步选择在11次决策内将欧几里得状态范数降至0.01以下（对任意符号均成立），而短视的一步选择在零输入后立即失去可行性。在模拟双臂装配任务中，我们算法的一步实现利用间隙反馈在名义摩擦条件下完成装配，在方法完成时刻，其相对位置误差的无穷范数较参考跟踪基线降低96.4%。在较低摩擦条件下，其后验条件化处理成功检测到空可行集，而固定先验的替代方法则允许了违反条件递减约束的动作。项目页面：https://clintonenwerem.com/belief-hybrid-control/。

Authors: Clinton Enwerem, Saleh Kemal, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

OntoPlan: An Ontology-Grounded Scene Representation and Agentic Framework for Scalable Robot Task Planning Other

ontology-grounded scene representation agentic framework robot task planning LLM spatial reasoning

简要说明：OntoPlan提出了基于本体的场景表示和智能体框架，增强了LLM在大型环境中执行长期任务规划的能力，显著提高了成功率与令牌效率，并能处理模糊或不可执行的指令。

TLDR: OntoPlan introduces an ontology-grounded scene representation and agentic framework that enhances LLM-based robot task planning for long-horizon tasks in large environments, significantly improving success rates and token efficiency while handling ambiguous or infeasible instructions.

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based robot task planning is promising for open-ended instruction following, but degrades on long-horizon tasks in large environments. When spatial information is conveyed to the LLM through text, the model can fail to capture spatial context, and token cost grows with environment size. Generating action sequences directly with an LLM also makes it difficult to satisfy the current world state and action preconditions. We address this with an ontology-grounded scene representation that aligns objects, spaces, relations, and states in a shared symbolic vocabulary for spatial reasoning and task planning, and with OntoPlan, an agentic framework that interprets instructions, selectively retrieves task-relevant information, formalizes goals and constraints, and produces executable plans. Across 150 general tasks spanning five indoor environments and three scene scales, OntoPlan achieves 0.89 average task success, compared with 0.27 for the strongest baseline, while using 18.1k total tokens per task on average, about 5.6$\times$ fewer than the most efficient baseline. These advantages persist as scene scale increases, whereas prior methods degrade more sharply in success and remain far more costly in tokens. OntoPlan also responds appropriately to ambiguous or infeasible instructions by asking follow-up questions or reporting insufficient information rather than committing to invalid plans. Code available at https://github.com/namhyeongwoo/OntoPlan.

摘要（中文）：基于大语言模型（LLM）的机器人任务规划在开放式指令跟随方面展现出良好前景，但在大规模环境下的长时程任务中性能会显著下降。当空间信息通过文本传递给大语言模型时，模型难以准确捕捉空间上下文，且令牌开销随环境规模增大而增长。此外，直接利用大语言模型生成动作序列，也难以保证动作满足当前世界状态及前置条件。为解决上述问题，本文提出一种基于本体论（ontology）的场景表示方法，将对象、空间、关系与状态统一映射到共享符号词汇表中，以支持空间推理与任务规划；同时提出智能体框架OntoPlan，该框架能够解释指令、选择性地检索与任务相关的信息、形式化目标与约束，并生成可执行的规划。在涵盖五个室内环境、三种场景规模的150个通用任务中，OntoPlan平均任务成功率达0.89，而最强基线仅为0.27；同时，OntoPlan平均每任务使用18.1k总令牌，较最高效的基线减少约5.6倍。随着场景规模增大，上述优势依然保持，而现有方法在成功率上下降更为显著，且令牌开销远高于OntoPlan。此外，OntoPlan能够对模糊或不可执行的指令作出恰当回应，通过提出追问或报告信息不足来避免生成无效规划。代码已开源，见 https://github.com/namhyeongwoo/OntoPlan。

Authors: Hyeongwoo Nam, Woongje Cho, Juwon Kim, Jongeun Choi

Beyond Task Reward: A Controller-Restriction Protocol for Evaluating Embodiment-Dependent Competence Locomotion

co-design controller-restriction embodied competence EvoGym morphology evaluation

简要说明：本文提出一种控制器受限协议来评估协同设计机器人形态的具身能力，表明仅靠任务奖励不足，且受限控制指标提供了更可靠、依赖控制器族的表征。

TLDR: This paper proposes a controller-restriction protocol to evaluate embodied competence of co-designed robot morphologies, showing that task reward alone is insufficient and that the restricted-control metric provides a more reliable, family-dependent characterization.

Abstract: Co-design methods optimize a robot's body and controller jointly and judge the result by one number, the task reward of the fully optimized pair. That number cannot separate morphologies whose competence depends on the controller to very different degrees. We evaluate a morphology by restricting its controller instead, recording the task competence it retains under an explicitly declared, low-complexity controller family, environment, task and search budget. On three EvoGym locomotion tasks, task reward explains only $39\%$, $33\%$ and $10\%$ of the variance in this quantity, and geometric descriptors do not predict it under run-grouped cross-validation. The measurement is reliable across optimizer restarts (ICC$(2,k) = 0.956$--$0.986$) but depends on the declared family: phasing the drive by actuator index instead of position ranks the same morphologies at Spearman $0.50$--$0.63$ and reverses reward-matched pairs. As a second search objective the axis improved competence at matched task reward in $3$ of $5$ paired runs, short of a pre-registered bar of $4$. Used after an ordinary reward-only search instead, to choose within its top task-reward band, it selected a different body in all $8$ runs offering a choice, at a cost of at most $0.10$ reward units, and in $6$ of $8$ that body also scored higher under a held-out family. Restricted-control competence is therefore a reportable property of a co-designed morphology, interpretable only with the controller family that defines it.

摘要（中文）：共同设计方法会同时优化机器人的本体与控制器，并以一个数值——即充分优化后的本体-控制器配对的任务奖励——来判断结果。该数值无法区分那些能力对控制器依赖程度差异显著的不同形态。我们转而通过限制控制器来评估某一形态，记录其在明确声明、低复杂度的控制器族、环境、任务及搜索预算下所保留的任务能力。在三个EvoGym运动任务中，任务奖励仅能解释该指标方差的$39\%$、$33\%$和$10\%$，且几何描述符在按运行分组交叉验证下无法预测该指标。该测量在优化器多次重启间具有可靠性（ICC$(2,k) = 0.956$--$0.986$），但依赖于所声明的控制器族：若按执行器索引而非位置进行相位驱动，同一组形态的Spearman排序相关系数为$0.50$--$0.63$，并且会使奖励匹配的配对排序反转。将该指标作为第二搜索目标时，在$5$次配对运行中有$3$次在匹配任务奖励下提升了能力，未达到预先登记的$4$次门槛。若仅在普通纯奖励搜索之后使用，用于在其最高任务奖励区间内进行选择，则在全部$8$次提供选择的运行中均选出了不同的本体，奖励代价最多为$0.10$个单位，且在$8$次中的$6$次中，该本体在留出控制器族下也取得了更高得分。因此，受限控制能力是共同设计形态的一项可报告属性，且必须结合定义其的控制器族来加以解释。

Authors: Siyuan Zhang

Nine Trials to Recover: A Reproducible Benchmark for Repertoire-Free Soft-Robot Damage Adaptation RLRobot

soft-robot damage recovery repertoire-free benchmark Gaussian-process expected improvement online adaptation worst-mask recovery

简要说明：本文提出了一个无需预置技能库的软体机器人损伤适应可复现基准，在75个机体上评估GP-EI控制器相比基线的优势，并展示了在严格部署门控下的恢复改进。

TLDR: This paper introduces a reproducible benchmark for soft-robot damage adaptation without a repertoire, evaluating a GP-EI controller against baselines on 75 bodies and showing improved recovery with a strict deployment gate.

Abstract: We present a repertoire-free benchmark for soft-robot damage recovery under nine online trials. The protocol pairs damage masks within each morphology, retains a measured nominal fallback, and separates method development from evaluation on new bodies. A Gaussian-process expected-improvement (GP-EI) reference controller adapts actuator phases using three initialization probes and six feedback-selected rollouts. Across two disjoint 75-body cohorts, it outperforms random search, Sobol, CEM, and CMA-ES under equal budgets. GP-EI improves the worst-mask gain on 69/75 confirmation bodies and exceeds these four baselines by 0.235-0.310 mean worst-mask reward. A TuRBO-style local GP is the closest comparator; the paired confidence interval includes zero. Post-confirmation fixed-controller replay finds 5.06 voxel widths of mean recovery together with a 0.0031 increase in worst-mask p99 geometric edge strain; a strict no-added-demand deployment gate retains 48.7% of mean gain. In a frozen development stress test that physically removes 10% of occupied voxels, GP-EI improves 71/75 bodies and exceeds official BoTorch TuRBO by 0.356 mean worst-mask gain. Together, the replayable controllers, body-level inference, and frozen-cohort evaluation provide a reference for measuring the added value of learned damage priors and future adaptation methods.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种无需预设动作库的基准测试方法，用于在九项在线试验中评估软体机器人的损伤恢复能力。该协议在同一形态内部配对损伤掩膜，保留一个经过测量的标称回退方案，并将方法开发与在新本体上的评估分开进行。一种基于高斯过程期望改进（GP-EI）的参考控制器利用三次初始化探测和六次反馈选择的滚动执行来调整执行器相位。在两个不相交的75个本体组成的队列中，在相同预算下，该方法优于随机搜索、Sobol、CEM和CMA-ES。GP-EI在69/75个确认本体上提升了最差掩膜的增益，并在平均最差掩膜奖励上超过这四种基线方法0.235–0.310。采用TuRBO风格的局部高斯过程是最接近的对比方法；配对置信区间包含零值。确认后的固定控制器重放实验显示，平均恢复量达到5.06个体素宽度，同时最差掩膜的p99几何边缘应变增加了0.0031；严格的“无额外需求”部署门控保留了48.7%的平均增益。在一项冻结开发压力测试中（实际移除10%的占据体素），GP-EI在71/75个本体上取得改进，并超过官方BoTorch TuRBO的平均最差掩膜增益0.356。综上，可重放控制器、本体级推断和冻结队列评估为衡量学习损伤先验及未来自适应方法的增益价值提供了参考基准。

Authors: Siyuan Zhang

Learning Grasp Targeting from Point Clouds for Log Pile Clearing on a Hydraulic Crane Manipulation

point cloud grasping behavior cloning reinforcement learning hydraulic crane sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于点云和液压起重机进行原木堆清理的抓取目标学习策略，实验表明在仿真中训练的策略在实地试验中优于几何启发式方法。

TLDR: This paper presents a learned policy for grasp targeting in log pile clearing using point clouds and a hydraulic crane, demonstrating that simulation-trained policies outperform a geometric heuristic in field trials.

Abstract: In mill yards, log loaders clear dense piles by a sequence of bundle grasps: hundreds of logs rest in contact, and each removal changes the pile available to the next grasp. A learned policy chooses where to place and orient the grapple from unsegmented point clouds and runs on a trailer-mounted hydraulic forestry crane. The policy classifies at which observed point to grasp and predicts depth and grapple orientation there. The same network outputs support behavior cloning (BC), reinforcement learning (RL), and deployment. BC learns from successful top-of-pile demonstrations; RL explores for improvements by fine-tuning the cloned policy (BC$\to$RL) or by training from scratch. In simulation, BC clears 98 of 100 piles of 200 logs, while BC$\to$RL improves load stability. Twelve field trials compare a geometric heuristic, RL from scratch, BC, and BC$\to$RL through complete grasp-transport-deposit cycles. BC and BC$\to$RL deposit 93.8% and 88.9% of pooled inventory, against 80.4% for the heuristic. BC$\to$RL deposits logs on 83.6% of its cycles, against 79.6% for the heuristic and 65.7% for BC, while its simulated stability gain does not carry over to the crane testbed. Trained entirely in simulation and run unchanged on the crane, the learned policies clear more than the hand-filtered heuristic while observing unfiltered clouds that still contain the storage rack's rails and poles.

摘要（中文）：在贮木场中，原木装载机通过一系列抓捆动作清理密集的料堆：数百根原木相互接触堆放，每一次移除都会改变下一次抓取时可用的料堆状态。一种学习策略从未分割的点云中决定抓斗的放置位置和姿态，并在拖车式液压林业起重机上运行。该策略对观测点中的哪个位置应被抓取进行分类，并预测该处的深度及抓斗姿态。同一网络输出同时支持行为克隆（BC）、强化学习（RL）及实际部署。BC从成功的堆顶示范中学习；RL通过微调克隆策略（BC→RL）或从零开始训练来探索改进。在仿真中，BC成功清理了100堆中98堆各含200根原木的料堆，而BC→RL则提升了负载稳定性。十二次现场试验比较了几何启发式方法、从零训练的RL、BC及BC→RL在完整抓取-运输-卸放循环中的表现。BC和BC→RL分别卸放了总库存的93.8%和88.9%，而启发式方法仅为80.4%。BC→RL在其83.6%的循环中成功卸放原木，相比启发式方法的79.6%和BC的65.7%有所提升，但其仿真中的稳定性优势并未在起重机测试平台上体现。完全在仿真中训练并直接在起重机上未作修改运行的策略，在观察仍包含存储架轨道和立柱的未滤波点云的情况下，清理效果优于人工滤波的启发式方法。

Authors: George Sideris, Lucas Bessai, Heshan Fernando, Elie Ayoub, Nicolas Lemieux, Inna Sharf

The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies RLRobot

representation robustness cross-embodiment evaluation morphology-aware policies gauge conventions framework independence

简要说明：本文提出GaugeBench基准，通过在保持物理机制不变的情况下改变机器人描述约定（如关节轴方向、零位角）来评估形态感知策略，发现现有跨形态策略存在严重的鲁棒性缺陷，并证明通过精确变换或针对性训练可以恢复性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces GaugeBench, a benchmark that evaluates morphology-aware robot policies by changing the robot description conventions (e.g., joint-axis direction, zero angles) while keeping the physical mechanism fixed, revealing a severe robustness failure in existing cross-embodiment policies and showing that exact transformations or targeted training can recover performance.

Abstract: A robot description does more than specify a physical mechanism: it also encodes arbitrary conventions, such as joint-axis direction, joint-angle zero, and the order and names of links and joints. Morphology-aware policies consume interfaces built from these descriptions, yet cross-embodiment evaluation typically changes the robot while keeping those conventions fixed. This leaves a simple question unanswered: does behavior survive when the robot stays fixed but its description changes? GaugeBench isolates this case by rewriting a fixed mechanism under physically equivalent conventions, verifying that its physics and policy interface are preserved, and then evaluating the same policy weights. The result is stark: three MetaMorph policies score 4030.6 on 80 familiar robots, but only 51.6 when those same robots are equivalently re-described, while 98 genuinely held-out robots score 1489.6. A new description can therefore be more damaging than a new robot. Tracing the failure reveals that axis reversal alone reproduces the collapse, joint-angle zero changes are nearly harmless, and reordering lies between them; moreover, changing joint-state and torque coordinates alone is sufficient to cause the failure, while changing description-derived features alone is not. The same phenomenon appears in ModuMorph and an unrelated PyBullet framework. Yet it is not irreversible: exact two-description transport restores the original controller, and training across equivalent axis conventions raises retained return under axis reversal from 3.6% to 80.6%. Together, these results separate mechanism robustness from representation robustness and show that cross-embodiment evaluation should test both.

摘要（中文）：机器人描述不仅仅指定物理机制：它还编码了任意约定，例如关节轴方向、关节角零点以及连杆和关节的顺序与名称。形态感知策略使用基于这些描述构建的接口，然而跨实体评估通常在保持这些约定不变的情况下更换机器人。这留下了一个简单的问题未得到解答：当机器人保持不变但其描述发生改变时，行为是否仍然能够存续？GaugeBench通过在同一固定机制下重写物理等价的约定，验证其物理特性和策略界面保持不变，然后评估相同的策略权重，从而隔离了这种情况。结果是惊人的：三个MetaMorph策略在80个熟悉机器人上得分为4030.6，但当这些相同的机器人被等价地重新描述时，得分仅为51.6，而98个真正留出的机器人得分为1489.6。因此，新的描述可能比新的机器人更具破坏性。追踪失败原因发现，仅轴反转即可重现这种崩溃，关节角零点的变化几乎无害，而重排序介于两者之间；此外，仅更改关节状态和力矩坐标就足以导致失败，而仅更改源自描述的特征则不会。同样的现象出现在ModuMorph和一个无关的PyBullet框架中。然而，这并非不可逆转：精确的双描述传输可以恢复原始控制器，而在等价轴约定上进行训练可将轴反转下的保留回报从3.6%提升至80.6%。这些结果共同将机制鲁棒性与表征鲁棒性区分开来，并表明跨实体评估应同时检验这两者。

Authors: Rahath Malladi, Arshia Sangwan, Rajesh K. Gupta, Tauhidur Rahman

OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception Perception3D

3D scene graph Gaussian Splatting open-vocabulary perception semantic mapping robot perception

简要说明：OpenSplatGraph 直接从在线基于高斯的开放词汇语义地图构建持久化 3D 场景图，支持可靠性感知的目标提取和增量关系更新，用于语言引导的机器人感知与推理。

TLDR: OpenSplatGraph constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic maps, enabling reliability-aware object extraction and incremental relationship updates for language-guided robot perception and reasoning.

Abstract: Dense 3D mapping with semantic understanding is essential for robotic perception in complex environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mapping approaches enable high-fidelity geometry and efficient open-vocabulary perception, but typically represent semantics as unstructured feature fields that limit object-centric reasoning. In contrast, 3D scene graphs explicitly model objects and their relationships for structured reasoning, but are commonly constructed from sparse geometric representations that do not fully exploit dense semantic maps. In this work, we present OpenSplatGraph, a unified framework that constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from an online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic map. The proposed framework augments the dense semantic map with a reliability-aware semantic field that maintains lightweight observation statistics for confidence-aware, query-conditioned object extraction. Extracted object instances are associated with persistent graph nodes, allowing object attributes and relationships to be incrementally updated across observations and queries. By tightly coupling dense semantic mapping with persistent object-centric representations, our framework supports both language-guided object grounding and structured relational reasoning while preserving the geometric fidelity of Gaussian-based mapping. Comprehensive evaluations on standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that OpenSplatGraph achieves competitive performance for online open-vocabulary perception and downstream robotic tasks. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph.

摘要（中文）：面向复杂环境下机器人感知，具备语义理解能力的稠密三维建图至关重要。近年来，基于三维高斯泼溅的建图方法实现了高保真几何建模与高效开放词汇感知，但其语义通常以非结构化特征场的形式表示，限制了以对象为中心的推理能力。相比之下，三维场景图通过显式建模对象及其关系来支持结构化推理，但通常由稀疏几何表示构建，未能充分利用稠密语义图。本文提出OpenSplatGraph，一种统一框架，可直接从基于高斯过程的在线开放词汇语义图中构建持久化三维场景图。该框架通过可靠性感知语义场对稠密语义图进行增强，维护轻量级观测统计信息，以支持置信度感知、查询条件下的对象提取。提取的对象实例与持久化图节点关联，使得对象属性和关系可在多次观测和查询中增量更新。通过将稠密语义建图与持久化对象中心表示紧密耦合，本框架在保持基于高斯的几何建图精度的同时，支持语言引导的对象定位与结构化关系推理。在标准三维场景理解基准及真实机器人实验上的综合评估表明，OpenSplatGraph在在线开放词汇感知及下游机器人任务中取得了有竞争力的性能。项目主页：https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph。

Authors: Binh Long Nguyen, Kien Nguyen, Clinton Fookes, Peyman Moghadam

Preserving Unstable Modes Through Inverse Dynamics in JEPA World Models WorldModel

JEPA inverse dynamics control-aware representation unstable modes visual control

简要说明：本文提出在JEPA世界模型中引入逆动力学（动作重建）目标，以保留学习到的视觉表征中可控的不稳定模态，证明了精确的动作重建使编码器在可达子空间上是单射的，并在非线性视觉控制任务中展示了经验优势。

TLDR: This paper proposes augmenting JEPA world models with an inverse dynamics (action reconstruction) objective to preserve controllable unstable modes in learned visual representations, proving that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the reachable subspace and showing empirical benefits on nonlinear visual control tasks.

Abstract: Robotic systems often exhibit unstable modes, along which small perturbations and disturbances can cause unbounded growth unless corrected through feedback. Controlling such systems from high-dimensional visual observations requires representations that preserve these modes. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) provide a natural framework for learning such representations and their dynamics from visual data. However, we demonstrate that next step prediction combined with anti-collapse regularization does not guarantee that controllable unstable modes are preserved: the training loss can be minimized while these modes are collapsed, making stabilization from the learned representation impossible. To address this, we augment world-model training with an action reconstruction objective (i.e., an inverse dynamics loss) that encourages control-aware representations, namely, visual representations that preserve crucial features for control. We prove that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the finite-horizon reachable subspace. Thus, the encoder cannot discard any state direction reachable by an action sequence within $H$ steps. Moreover, we show that, as $H$ grows, the dominant eigenspace of the finite-horizon controllability Gramian converges to the controllable unstable subspace. We establish our theoretical results for linear systems and demonstrate empirically that our findings extend to nonlinear visual control tasks (CartPole, Walker2D, and PointMaze), highlighting the benefits of control-aware representation learning.

摘要（中文）：机器人系统通常表现出不稳定模态，在这些模态下，微小的扰动和干扰除非通过反馈加以纠正，否则可能导致状态无界增长。从高维视觉观测中控制此类系统，需要能够保留这些模态的表示。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）为从视觉数据中学习此类表示及其动态提供了一种自然框架。然而，我们证明，将下一步预测与防坍缩正则化相结合，并不能保证可控的不稳定模态得以保留：训练损失可以在这些模态坍缩的同时达到最小，从而使基于所学表示的稳定化无法实现。为解决这一问题，我们在世界模型训练中增加了动作重建目标（即逆动力学损失），以鼓励具备控制感知能力的表示，即保留对控制至关重要的特征的视觉表示。我们证明，精确的动作重建使得编码器在有限时域可达子空间上是单射的。因此，编码器无法丢弃任何在$H$步动作序列内可达的状态方向。此外，我们表明，随着$H$增大，有限时域可控性格拉姆矩阵的主特征空间收敛于可控不稳定子空间。我们针对线性系统建立了理论结果，并通过实验证明我们的发现可推广至非线性视觉控制任务（CartPole、Walker2D和PointMaze），从而突显了控制感知表示学习的优势。

Authors: Leonardo F. Toso, Yann LeCun, James Anderson, Oumayma Bounou

What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot Locomotion

humanoid navigation semantic-aware locomotion execution-aware navigation closed-loop VLN hazard avoidance

简要说明：本文提出了一个针对人形机器人导航的基准和闭环框架，解决高程图中难以察觉的危险和命令执行偏差，并在仿真和实体Unitree G1机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark and closed-loop framework for humanoid robot navigation that addresses elevation-map-subtle hazards and execution deviations, validated in simulation and on a physical Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Navigation for humanoid robots is critical, yet large-scale evaluation on physical hardware is often impractical due to cost and safety concerns, making simulation benchmarks essential. Existing VLN benchmarks achieve physically executable navigation, but still assume (1) all hazards are observable from elevation maps; (2) realized motions closely match desired motions. In real environments, however, fallen bottles may be ambiguous in elevation maps, while phones and water spills may be difficult to differentiate; hazard avoidance by the locomotion policy can cause the robot's actual trajectory to deviate from the path intended by the VLN policy. Such command-execution mismatch can accumulate and lead the robot toward unintended locations. To expose these failure modes, we introduce a benchmark that models both elevation-subtle hazards and execution deviations, together with a closed-loop VLN + locomotion control framework that continuously realigns high-level navigation with the robot's actual state. We evaluate navigation in simulation and further validate the locomotion policy on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Results show that semantic input reduces contact with hazards poorly represented in elevation maps, while anti-deviation improves navigation success. These findings highlight the need to evaluate humanoid navigation jointly in terms of route completion and hazard avoidance.

摘要（中文）：对人形机器人的导航至关重要，然而，由于成本和安全问题，在物理硬件上进行大规模评估往往不切实际，这使得仿真基准测试变得不可或缺。现有的视觉语言导航基准测试虽能实现物理上可执行的导航，但仍假设：(1) 所有危险均可从高程图中观测到；(2) 实际运动与预期运动高度一致。然而，在真实环境中，倒下的瓶子在高程图中可能模糊不清，而手机与洒出的液体也可能难以区分；运动策略为避免危险所采取的动作，可能导致机器人实际轨迹偏离视觉语言导航策略规划的路径。这种指令与执行之间的偏差可能不断累积，最终将机器人引向非预期位置。为暴露上述失效模式，我们提出了一种基准测试，同时模拟高程细微危险与执行偏差，并构建了闭环的视觉语言导航与运动控制框架，持续将高层导航与机器人实际状态重新对齐。我们在仿真环境中评估导航性能，并在实体Unitree G1人形机器人上进一步验证运动策略。结果表明，语义输入减少了对高程图中表征不佳的危险的接触，而防偏差机制则提升了导航成功率。这些发现强调了对人形机器人导航进行路线完成度与危险规避联合评估的必要性。

Authors: Shunyu Yao, Songyang Liu, Dinghao Chen, Yuanyuan Lei, Shuai Li

Trajectory Planning without Trajectory Data: A Manifold-Guided Approach Manipulation

manifold learning trajectory planning state-space motion planning unsupervised

简要说明：本文提出Ariadne，一种仅从状态观测学习状态空间流形并利用其几何结构构建可行路径的轨迹规划方法，无需专家轨迹数据。它能泛化到未见过的起点-目标组合，并在高维双臂规划基准上与轨迹监督和经典规划器竞争。

TLDR: This paper proposes Ariadne, a trajectory planning method that learns a state-space manifold from state observations only and constructs feasible paths using the manifold's geometry, eliminating the need for expert trajectory data. It generalizes to unseen start-goal pairs and is competitive with trajectory-supervised and classical planners on high-dimensional dual-arm planning benchmarks.

Abstract: A common way for trajectory planning is to leverage generative models trained on large collections of expert trajectories. At inference time, the model generates executable trajectories by conditioning on task goal constraints. However, trajectory-based methods rely on costly supervision, scale poorly with sequence length, and often generalize poorly to unseen constraints such as novel start-goal pairs. We propose an alternative to learn the underlying state-space manifold and use the geometry of the manifold for trajectory planning. This approach requires only state observations and enables generalization to unseen constraints by con- structing trajectories on the learned manifold of the state space. Experiments on Maze2D and robotic motion-planning benchmarks show that Ariadne constructs feasible paths from state-only supervision and generalizes to unseen start-goal combinations. On high-dimensional dual-arm planning, it remains competitive with trajectory-supervised and classical planners, while requiring no trajectory data for training.

摘要（中文）：轨迹规划的一种常见方式是利用在大量专家轨迹数据集上训练得到的生成模型。在推理阶段，该模型通过给定任务目标约束来生成可执行的轨迹。然而，基于轨迹的方法依赖昂贵的监督信号，在序列长度增加时扩展性较差，并且往往难以泛化到未见过的约束条件，例如新的起点-目标点组合。我们提出一种替代方案，即学习状态空间的底层流形，并利用该流形的几何结构进行轨迹规划。该方法仅需状态观测数据，并能够通过在所学状态空间流形上构建轨迹，实现对未见约束的泛化。在Maze2D和机器人运动规划基准测试上的实验表明，Ariadne仅凭状态监督即可构建可行路径，并能泛化到未见的起点-目标点组合。在高维双臂规划任务中，该方法与基于轨迹监督的方法及经典规划器相比仍具竞争力，且训练过程中无需任何轨迹数据。

Authors: Silong Yong, Anji Liu, Cunxi Dai, Carl Busart, Guanya Shi, Yilun Du, Katia Sycara, Yaqi Xie

SharedKV-BT: Node-Local Typed Decisions for Behavior-Tree Agents Manipulation

behavior tree shared-prefix KV parallel decision scoring robot manipulation closed-loop control

简要说明：SharedKV-BT通过共享前缀KV缓存并行评分行为树节点的候选决策，加速类型化决策，并在机器人操作和导航任务中提升闭环成功率。

TLDR: SharedKV-BT accelerates typed decisions for behavior-tree agents by scoring node-local candidates in parallel via shared-prefix KV caching, improving speed and closed-loop success on robot manipulation and navigation.

Abstract: Agent tasks require sequences of interdependent decisions. Autoregressive models support more flexible decision interfaces than conventional classifiers but incur the latency of token-by-token generation. Recent shared-prefix methods reduce this cost by reusing encoded context and scoring multiple decisions in parallel, but do not model decision dependencies or verify execution. We propose SharedKV-BT, where each active node of a behavior tree (BT) exposes stage-local fields and candidates, and Shared-KV scores the candidates in parallel and passes the selected decision to a separate execution system. We tested SharedKV-BT on robot manipulation, mobile navigation, and computer-use tasks. Across three tasks, SharedKV-BT made typed decisions 2.36-4.15 times faster than prompt-matched autoregressive decoding. On the manipulation task, node-local Shared-KV improved joint decision accuracy from 75% to 94% and closed-loop success from 0% to 60%. Fixed-score policy replay showed that stage gating prevented out-of-order actions and external postconditions prevented premature completion.

摘要（中文）：智能体任务需要一系列相互依赖的决策。自回归模型相较于传统分类器支持更灵活的决策接口，但会带来逐词生成的延迟。近期的共享前缀方法通过复用已编码的上下文并并行评分多个决策来降低这一成本，但未能建模决策依赖关系或验证执行过程。我们提出了SharedKV-BT方法，其中行为树（BT）的每个活动节点暴露阶段局部字段和候选决策，Shared-KV并行对这些候选进行评分，并将选定决策传递给独立的执行系统。我们在机器人操作、移动导航和计算机使用任务上测试了SharedKV-BT。在三个任务中，SharedKV-BT的判定决策速度比提示匹配的自回归解码快2.36至4.15倍。在操作任务中，节点局部Shared-KV将联合决策准确率从75%提升至94%，闭环成功率从0%提升至60%。固定评分策略回放实验表明，阶段门控防止了乱序动作，外部后置条件防止了过早完成。

Authors: Naoki Wake, Justin Wagle

Towards Decentralized Formation of Minimum-Length Communication Networks Using Robot Swarms Other

decentralized robot swarms communication networks multi-robot Steiner tree

简要说明：该论文提出了一种完全去中心化的框架，使机器人群体通过局部交互形成并维护通信网络，在保证连通性的同时最小化网络长度，并通过仿真和实物多机器人实验验证了其性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a fully decentralized framework for robot swarms to form and maintain communication networks, using local interactions to minimize network length while guaranteeing connectivity and bounding worst-case performance to shortest starlike trees, validated through simulations and physical multi-robot experiments.

Abstract: Multi-robot missions in infrastructure-denied environments frequently rely on reliable communication links between spatially separated locations. We propose a fully decentralized framework for constructing and dynamically maintaining communication networks without centralized topology planning or global positioning infrastructure. Driven strictly by local interactions, robots reconfigure local network topologies and adjust their physical positions to minimize overall network length while adhering to communication constraints. Formal analysis shows that our local reconfiguration operations guarantee continuous network connectivity, strictly decrease network length with every branch transfer, and bound worst-case performance to the shortest starlike tree. Embodied simulations and physical multi-robot experiments confirm that our approach forms networks near the length of centrally computed Euclidean Steiner trees. Additionally, the system dynamically adapts to moving targets and optimizes deployment by utilizing only necessary connectors, preserving excess robots for auxiliary tasks. This work enables autonomous swarms to self-organize adaptive ad hoc communication infrastructure in communication-denied environments, which could support applications varying from subterranean exploration to planetary missions.

摘要（中文）：在缺乏基础设施的环境中执行多机器人任务时，通常依赖于空间分离位置之间可靠的通信链路。我们提出了一种完全分布式的框架，用于构建和动态维护通信网络，无需集中的拓扑规划或全局定位基础设施。仅依靠局部交互，机器人重新配置局部网络拓扑并调整自身物理位置，以在满足通信约束的同时最小化整体网络长度。形式化分析表明，我们的局部重配置操作能够保证网络持续连通，每次分支转移都严格缩短网络长度，并将最坏情况下的性能限定在最短星形树范围内。物理仿真和实际多机器人实验结果表明，该方法生成的网络长度接近集中计算的欧几里得斯坦纳树。此外，该系统能够动态适应移动目标，并且仅利用必要的中继节点来优化部署，从而将多余机器人保留用于辅助任务。这项工作使得自主群体能够在通信受限环境中自组织形成自适应临时通信基础设施，可支撑从地下探测到行星任务等多种应用场景。

Authors: Genki Miyauchi, Mohamed S. Talamali, Julian Rau, Roderich Groß

CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks HumanoidEmbodied

continual instruction reconciliation LLM semantic reasoning instruction integration household tasks humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出了CIRRA，一种面向具身家庭机器人的持续指令协调双层级框架，利用基于LLM的语义推理和规则约束的结构化集成为正在执行的任务计划整合新的用户指令。作者还提出了CHIRP文本基准，并在Unitree G1人形机器人上验证了CIRRA的有效性，在决策一致性和执行正确性上优于基线方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces CIRRA, a dual-level framework for continual instruction reconciliation in embodied household robots, which integrates new user instructions into ongoing task plans using LLM-based semantic reasoning and rule-constrained structural integration. The authors also present CHIRP, a text-based benchmark, and demonstrate the effectiveness of CIRRA on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, outperforming baselines in decision agreement and execution correctness.

Abstract: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.

摘要（中文）：家用机器人必须在执行持续任务的同时接纳新的用户指令。现有智能体往往会重新生成或大幅修订剩余任务序列，从而引入计划歧义、逻辑不一致及冗余执行等问题。我们提出了持续指令调和（Continual Instruction Reconciliation）这一概念，并据此构建了CIRRA（面向机器人智能体的持续指令调和框架），该框架是一种双层机制，将基于大语言模型的语义推理与规则约束的结构整合相结合。CIRRA首先将输入指令映射至明确的、可执行的技能，并解析其中未明确指定的动作与执行位置；随后，它保留当前正在进行的子任务序列作为执行主干，并通过在位置匹配的片段中插入输入子任务来生成整合候选方案。语义推理器仅对修改过的片段进行评估，以识别依赖关系与冲突，并选取逻辑上最为连贯的局部整合结果。这一结构保持型流程确保与持续执行进程保持对齐，降低了歧义与不一致性，同时通过复用共享子任务来减少冗余执行。我们还引入了CHIRP（持续家庭指令调和与规划）基准，这是一个基于文本的基准测试集，涵盖八个家庭环境及六类日常活动的120个任务片段。在CHIRP上，CIRRA达到了74.2%的决策一致率，比最强的重新规划基线高出30个百分点；所有正确的融合决策均产生了位置正确且无冲突的调度方案。在Unitree G1人形机器人上，CIRRA在每次试验中均在正确时刻中断正在进行的技能，并在所有指标上显著优于所有基线方法。

Authors: Ci Zhang, Enfu Nan, Arman Akbari, Lin Zhao, Li Wang, Chen Wang, Weiwei Chen, Yanzhi Wang, Geng Yuan

Robust Nonprehensile Object Transport with Quadruped Robots Locomotion

nonprehensile manipulation quadruped robot trajectory optimization model predictive control whole-body control

简要说明：本文提出了一种四足机器人非抓取物体运输的鲁棒框架，结合不确定性感知的轨迹优化和耦合凸模型预测控制，在仿真和真实实验中减少了滑动和质心跟踪误差。

TLDR: This paper introduces a robust nonprehensile object transportation framework for quadruped robots, combining uncertainty-aware trajectory optimization with a coupled convex model predictive controller to reduce sliding and CoM tracking errors in simulations and real-world experiments.

Abstract: In this paper, we present a robust nonprehensile object transportation framework for quadruped robots. An uncertainty-aware trajectory optimization method generates object motions with minimal closed-loop sensitivity to uncertain parameters. The resulting reference trajectory is tracked using a coupled convex model predictive controller that jointly predicts the CoM dynamics of the quadruped and the payload followed by a whole-body QP that enforces ground reaction constraints. The approach is evaluated through extensive simulations and real-world experiments under variations in the object's inertial parameters. Its performance is compared with fixed-orientation and straight-line trajectories as baseline. The results show that the optimized object motion reduces the sliding by approximately 50% compared with the fixed-orientation baseline and 30% compared with the straight-line baseline, while also achieving lower robot CoM tracking errors.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种适用于四足机器人的鲁棒非抓取式物体运输框架。一种不确定性感知的轨迹优化方法生成物体运动，使闭环对不确定参数的敏感性最小化。所得的参考轨迹通过一个耦合的凸模型预测控制器进行跟踪，该控制器联合预测四足机器人质心动力学与负载，随后通过一个全身QP（二次规划）强制地面反作用力约束。该方法在物体惯性参数变化的条件下，通过广泛的仿真和实际实验进行评估。其性能与固定姿态和直线轨迹的基线进行了比较。结果表明，与固定姿态基线相比，优化后的物体运动将滑动减少了约50%；与直线基线相比，减少了约30%，同时实现了更低的机器人质心跟踪误差。

Authors: Ainoor Teimoorzadeh, Riccardo Pretto, Mario Selvaggio, Gokhan Alcan, Sami Haddadin

RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning Perception3D

egocentric robot learning data capture hardware SLAM depth estimation hand tracking

简要说明：RoboCap 提出了一种轻量级多摄像头帽子和设备无关的 3D 算法，用于以自我为中心的机器人数据收集，并在 SLAM、深度估计和手部追踪方面展示了最先进的性能。

TLDR: RoboCap introduces a lightweight multi-camera hat and device-agnostic 3D algorithms for egocentric robot data collection, demonstrating state-of-the-art SLAM, depth estimation, and hand tracking.

Abstract: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.

摘要（中文）：尽管其有望扩展机器人学习，但目前以自我为中心的操控数据仍然稀缺。大规模采集需要将人体工程学硬件与厘米级精度的3D算法进行垂直整合，而这一精度尚未在公开场合得到验证。为解决这一缺口，我们推出了RoboCap——一款重250克、配备六摄像头和双惯性测量单元（IMU）的帽子，专为野外自我中心数据采集设计，以及Grounded API——一套针对RoboCap调校的设备无关的3D算法套件。在本报告中，我们展示了硬件、标定与3D算法如何协同作用，在公开基准测试中取得最先进的性能：我们开发的SLAM在多种环境和支架配置下均表现优异，我们的深度估计在自我中心设置中效果出色，且我们的手部追踪在适配第三方设备时同样表现卓越。

Authors: Grounded Superintelligence, BitRobot

Sim-to-Real Transfer of Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments Using an Ackermann-Steered Mobile Robot VLN

Vision-Language Navigation Cross-Modal Attention Sim-to-Real Transfer Ackermann-steered robot Continuous environments

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于跨模态注意力模型的视觉-语言导航的仿真到现实迁移方法，应用于阿克曼转向移动机器人，无需导航图或全景视图，并通过有限的微调和光度调整实现了真实环境中的有效导航。

TLDR: This paper presents a sim-to-real transfer method for vision-language navigation using a cross-modal attention model on an Ackermann-steered mobile robot, requiring no navigation graphs or panoramic views, and demonstrates real-world adaptation with limited fine-tuning and photometric adjustments.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables robots to navigate through environments using natural language instructions, making human-robot interaction intuitive. Traditional VLN models often rely on navigation graphs, 360-degree views, and perfect localization which pose significant challenges when adapting these models to real-world settings. This work addresses these limitations by performing a simulation-to-real domain shift of a VLN approach that operates in continuous environments without requiring navigation graphs or panoramic views. The proposed system integrates vision-language models that align visual inputs and linguistic instructions within a shared embedding space, facilitating natural language-driven navigation. We employ a Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) based architecture trained on an existing dataset in a simulated environment and fine-tune it using real-world data collected from a custom-built Ackermann-steered robot equipped with a camera and a LiDAR sensor. By utilising linear photometric adjustments and fine-tuning on a limited number of episodes, our model successfully adapts to real-world environments, achieving effective navigation while running offline on dedicated hardware. Experimental results, evaluated using Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) and Normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) metrics, demonstrate the robustness and adaptability of our approach. Keywords: Vision-Language Navigation, Cross-Modal Attention, Natural Language Instructions, Sim-to-Real Transfer, Autonomous Navigation, Ackermann-steering.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航（VLN）使机器人能够通过自然语言指令在环境中导航，从而实现直观的人机交互。传统的VLN模型通常依赖导航图、360度视角以及精确的定位，这些要求在实际应用场景中给模型适配带来了显著挑战。本研究通过实现一种无需导航图或全景视角、可在连续环境中操作的VLN方法的仿真到现实域迁移，来应对上述限制。所提出的系统集成了视觉-语言模型，将视觉输入和语言指令在共享的嵌入空间中对齐，从而促进自然语言驱动的导航。我们采用基于跨模态注意力（CMA）的架构，在模拟环境中使用现有数据集进行训练，并利用从自建阿克曼转向机器人（配备摄像头和LiDAR传感器）采集的真实世界数据对模型进行微调。通过采用线性光度调整并在有限数量的片段上进行微调，我们的模型成功适应了真实环境，实现了有效的导航功能，并可在专用硬件上离线运行。采用路径长度加权成功率（SPL）和归一化动态时间规整（nDTW）指标进行评估的实验结果，验证了我们方法的鲁棒性和适应性。关键词：视觉-语言导航，跨模态注意力，自然语言指令，仿真到现实迁移，自主导航，阿克曼转向。

Authors: Chalindu Abeywansa, Sahan Gunasekara, Devindi De Silva, Seniru Dissanayake, Ranga Rodrigo, Peshala Jayasekara

EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces VLA

self-evolving harness optimization experience traces frozen model EmbodiedBench

简要说明：EMHO 提出了一种自我演化的框架，通过经验轨迹优化冻结具身模型的代理控制框架（规划、上下文、工具使用），在 EmbodiedBench 的导航和操作任务中提升了 Qwen 9B 和 27B 的成功率。

TLDR: EMHO presents a self-evolving framework that optimizes the agent harness (planning, context, tool use) of a frozen embodied model using experience traces, improving task success in EmbodiedBench navigation and manipulation for Qwen 9B and 27B.

Abstract: Improving embodied agents often focuses on optimizing the underlying model through training, while the surrounding agent harness that controls planning, context, and tool use is typically engineered. We ask whether this harness can instead improve itself directly from experience traces under sparse environmental feedback. We propose EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization (EMHO), a self-evolving framework that keeps the embodied model frozen and iteratively revises its harness by analyzing execution trajectories and prior harness history. EMHO optimizes beyond skills or recovery prompts, modifying how the agent monitors progress, uses vision tools, grounds observations, and responds to failures. To support multiple subtasks with a single harness, we introduce EMHO-Merge, which addresses trade-offs in jointly optimizing a single shared harness across subtasks by using episode-level gains and losses to guide evidence-supported refinement of when and how revised behaviors are applied. We evaluate EMHO on EmbodiedBench across navigation and manipulation tasks, and EMHO consistently improves task success for both Qwen 9B and 27B models. Qualitative analysis shows that EMHO goes beyond recovering from failures and unproductive actions to reshape how the embodied agent interprets and interacts with its environment.

摘要（中文）：改进具身智能体通常侧重于通过训练优化底层模型，而控制规划、上下文和工具使用的周边操控机制往往是人工设计的。我们探究这一操控机制能否在稀疏环境反馈下，直接根据经验轨迹实现自我改进。为此，我们提出具身智能体操控机制优化框架（EMHO），这是一个自我进化框架，在保持具身模型冻结的同时，通过分析执行轨迹和先前的操控机制历史来迭代修订其操控机制。EMHO的优化超越了技能或恢复提示的层面，它直接调整智能体监控进度、使用视觉工具、锚定观察结果以及应对失败的方式。为支持单一操控机制应对多个子任务，我们引入了EMHO-Merge，该机制通过利用片段级增益和损失来引导基于证据的精细化调整，解决跨子任务联合优化单一共享操控机制时的权衡问题。我们在EmbodiedBench上对EMHO进行了评估，涵盖导航和操作任务，结果表明EMHO持续提升了Qwen 9B和27B模型的任务成功率。定性分析显示，EMHO不仅限于从失败和低效动作中恢复，更重塑了具身智能体解释和互动其环境的方式。

Authors: Hyun Jung Lee, Jungtaek Kim, Jongwon Jeong, Tae-Eui Kam, Donghyun Kim, Yong Jae Lee

Attacca: Goal-Directed Control under State Continuity for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents Other

goal-conditioned policies long-horizon embodied agents context-decoupled goal sampling behavioral-phase conditioning target-mask prediction

简要说明：Attacca通过在Minecraft环境中解耦目标图像与执行环境，并引入目标掩码预测和行为阶段条件化，训练视觉目标条件策略以处理长期具身任务，显著超越先前方法。

TLDR: Attacca trains visual goal-conditioned policies on long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft by decoupling goal images from the execution environment and adding target-mask prediction and behavioral-phase conditioning, achieving large gains over prior methods.

Abstract: A central capability of embodied agents is to accomplish complex objectives through sequences of interdependent tasks. Yet existing visual goal-conditioned policies underlying these agents are typically evaluated on isolated interactions where the target is already visible, and thus do not capture the conditions that arise during continuous long-horizon task execution. In such settings, each task begins from the state left by the previous one: the agent may end at a different position and orientation, the world may have been modified, and the next interaction target may lie outside the current field of view. As a result, agents relying on such policies may struggle to proceed to the next task when they cannot ground their target in the current observation. To address this challenge, we propose Attacca, a new approach that trains visual goal-conditioned policies on complete search-to-interact trajectories using goal images decoupled from the execution environment. Attacca uses context-decoupled goal sampling to pair each demonstration with a class-compatible masked goal image from another world, removing direct scene and pose correspondence. It learns dense current-view grounding through a target-mask prediction head, providing auxiliary supervision beyond action imitation. We further introduce behavioral-phase conditioning that teaches the policy to distinguish Search, Approach, and Interact stages and adapt its control as execution progresses. We evaluate Attacca on multiple short- and long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft. Our method achieves 39.0-47.5% clean success, improving over the strongest baseline by 1.7-2.4x. On long-horizon tasks, it attains 54%, 30%, and 28% completion, yielding up to a 7x improvement.

摘要（中文）：具身智能体的核心能力在于通过一系列相互依赖的任务完成复杂目标。然而，现有支撑这些智能体的视觉目标条件策略通常在目标已可见的孤立交互场景中进行评估，因此无法捕捉连续长时段任务执行过程中出现的实际条件。在此类场景中，每个任务都从前一任务结束时的状态开始：智能体可能停留在不同的位置和朝向上，环境可能已被修改，而下一个交互目标可能位于当前视野之外。因此，依赖此类策略的智能体在当前观测中无法定位目标时，往往难以继续推进下一任务。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Attacca，一种新方法，利用与执行环境解耦的目标图像，在完整的“搜索—交互”轨迹上训练视觉目标条件策略。Attacca采用上下文解耦目标采样，将每条演示与来自另一世界的类别兼容掩蔽目标图像配对，消除直接的场景与位姿对应关系。通过学习稠密当前视角锚定（通过目标掩膜预测头实现），在动作模仿之外提供辅助监督。我们进一步引入行为阶段条件化，使策略学会区分搜索、接近和交互阶段，并在执行过程中动态调整控制策略。我们在Minecraft中的多个短时段与长时段具身任务上评估了Attacca。该方法实现了39.0%-47.5%的完全成功率，较最强基线提升1.7-2.4倍。在长时段任务中，完成率分别达到54%、30%和28%，实现最高7倍的性能提升。

Authors: Gyusik Seo, Jaehong Yoon

CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching WorldModel

video world models control-aware caching action-aware scheduling frequency-mixed history prior training-free acceleration

简要说明：CtrlCache 是一种无需训练、控制感知的缓存框架，通过利用动作转换来调度计算复用和频率混合历史先验引导，加速交互式视频世界模型，在不重新训练的情况下实现 1.21x-1.41x 的 DiT 骨干加速。

TLDR: CtrlCache is a training-free, control-aware caching framework that accelerates interactive video world models by using action transitions to schedule computation reuse and frequency-mixed history prior guidance, achieving 1.21x-1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without retraining.

Abstract: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

摘要（中文）：交互式视频世界模型需要在高效生成每个视频块的同时，忠实响应用户控制。许多系统采用分块自回归生成与少步去噪相结合的方式，但每个视频块仍需多次昂贵的去噪迭代。免训练缓存可降低此成本，然而现有策略主要依据模型内部的去噪动态做出复用决策，并未显式考虑控制切换。实际上，交互式生成显式暴露了一个它们未利用的信号：某一视频块的控制指令在去噪开始前即已到达，因此由此推导出的调度不会产生任何前向传播开销。为此，我们分析了不同控制模式下相邻视频块的特征，发现结构相似性在动作变化处显著下降，而低频结构比高频细节更具持续性。基于这些观察，我们提出CtrlCache——一种免训练、控制感知的缓存框架，能够根据当前控制序列自适应调整计算量。具体而言，动作感知调度与刷新策略检测块间及块内的动作变化，并将每个视频块标记为初始、过渡、转向或稳定状态。在选定的内部去噪步骤中，初始块与过渡块保留完整计算，而转向块与稳定块则复用同一视频块内最近一次完整计算步骤的Transformer残差。为利用稳定交互期间低频结构的持续性，我们进一步引入频率混合历史先验引导，在不增加额外DiT前向传播的情况下，融合前一个干净隐变量的互补信息。在Matrix-Game 2.0和LingBot-World v1/v2上的评估表明，CtrlCache在无需模型重训练的情况下实现了1.21倍至1.41倍的DiT骨干网络加速，并在所有三个模型上将WBench Overall得分相较于原始推理均有提升。

Authors: Shangye Song, Dong Gong, Hong Jia, Yun Sing Koh, Xinyu Zhang

From Laboratory to Road: Evaluating Wearable Gaze Accuracy for Driving AutonomousDriving

wearable gaze tracking gaze accuracy autonomous driving BEV supervision driver behavior

简要说明：本文提出了首个在真实驾驶条件下量化可穿戴式眼动仪精度的统一框架，发现平均道路误差为4.58度，通过室内修正偏移可降至1.10度，并强调可靠的BEV监督需要在线重校准和条件相关的不确定性估计。

TLDR: This paper presents the first unified framework for quantifying wearable gaze accuracy under real driving conditions, finding a mean on-road error of 4.58 degrees that can be reduced to 1.10 degrees with indoor-derived offset correction, highlighting the need for online recalibration for reliable BEV supervision.

Abstract: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations have become a widely used interface between perception and planning in autonomous driving, but they encode what is in a scene, not what is behaviorally relevant to a human driver. Gaze offers a compelling behavioral signal for this gap, yet wearable eye trackers are routinely deployed as if their spatial output were ground truth, despite known sensitivity to head motion, illumination, and calibration drift. We present, to our knowledge, the first unified framework for quantifying wearable gaze accuracy under real driving conditions. Our on-road study contains 41 validated scenes in which one driver fixated a vehicle's license plate. Gaze error is measured as the angular difference between the plate center and the gaze direction estimated by the glasses. Separate indoor studies with the same driver and device systematically analyze how distance, illumination, head motion, target motion, and gaze eccentricity affect both systematic bias and gaze precision. The mean on-road error was 4.58 degrees. Applying an offset estimated from the indoor recordings reduced it to 1.10 degrees and improved all 41 scenes. Because this offset varied between sessions, reliable BEV supervision may require online recalibration and condition-dependent estimates of gaze uncertainty.

摘要（中文）：鸟瞰视角（BEV）表示已成为自动驾驶中感知与规划之间广泛使用的接口，但它编码的是场景中的内容，而非与人类驾驶员行为相关的信息。注视为该缺口提供了一种有力的行为信号，然而可穿戴式眼动追踪仪在实际部署中往往被视作其空间输出即为地面真值，尽管已知其对头部运动、光照和校准漂移敏感。我们提出了据我们所知首个在真实驾驶条件下量化可穿戴式注视精度的统一框架。我们的实际道路研究包含41个经验证的场景，在这些场景中，一名驾驶员注视一辆车的车牌。注视误差以车牌中心与眼镜估计的注视方向之间的角度差来衡量。在同一驾驶员和设备条件下进行的独立室内研究系统性地分析了距离、光照、头部运动、目标运动及注视偏心率对系统偏差和注视精度的影响。实际道路的平均误差为4.58度。利用室内记录估计的偏移量进行校正后，误差降至1.10度，且所有41个场景均得到改善。由于该偏移量在不同会话间存在变化，可靠的BEV监督可能需要在线重新校准以及依赖于条件的注视不确定性估计。

Authors: William Engel, Fabian Flohr

GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry WorldModel

geometry world model flow-matching transformer future geometry forecasting camera-motion prediction autonomous driving

简要说明：GeoWM 利用几何基础模型和流匹配 transformer 直接预测未来 3D 场景几何，避免了递归展开，在驾驶、空中和操作数据集上提高了效率。

TLDR: GeoWM directly forecasts future 3D scene geometry using a geometry foundation model and flow-matching transformer, avoiding recursive rollout and improving efficiency across driving, aerial, and manipulation datasets.

Abstract: Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is essential for autonomous driving and robotics. A common paradigm is to use world models to predict future images or latent representations of the environment and subsequently recover geometry from these predictions. However, this paradigm does not explicitly model geometric structure and typically relies on recursive rollouts to reach longer prediction horizons, leading to error accumulation and increasing computational cost. To address these limitations, we present GeoWM, a geometry world model that directly forecasts future scene geometry at specified future horizons without recursive rollout. The key idea is to leverage a geometry foundation model to transform observed RGB frames into a geometric history, which conditions a flow-matching transformer to predict the scene geometry at a specified future horizon. We further show that a lightweight camera-motion predictor can accurately estimate the future viewpoint, and that projecting the observed geometry into the predicted viewpoint provides an effective geometric prior for future geometry forecasting. Extensive experiments on four datasets spanning urban driving, aerial flight, and dynamic manipulation demonstrate that GeoWM outperforms the evaluated world models in forecasting depth, camera pose, and 3D scene geometry, while substantially reducing inference time at longer horizons.

摘要（中文）：对3D场景几何及其随时间演变的建模对于自动驾驶和机器人技术至关重要。一种常见的范式是利用世界模型来预测环境的未来图像或潜在表示，随后从这些预测中恢复几何结构。然而，该范式并未显式建模几何结构，且通常依赖递归展开以到达更长的预测时域，这会导致误差累积并增加计算成本。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了GeoWM，一种几何世界模型，能够在指定未来时域直接预测未来场景几何，而无需递归展开。其关键思想在于利用几何基础模型将观测到的RGB帧转换为几何历史，该历史条件化一个流匹配变换器，以预测指定未来时域的场景几何。我们进一步证明，一个轻量级的相机运动预测器能够准确估计未来视角，并将观测到的几何投影到预测视角中，可为未来几何预测提供有效的几何先验。在涵盖城市驾驶、空中飞行和动态操作四个数据集上的大量实验表明，GeoWM在预测深度、相机姿态和3D场景几何方面优于所评估的世界模型，同时在较长时域下显著减少了推理时间。

Authors: Mehrdad Noori, Guile Wu, Sam Hosseini, Dongfeng Bai

Tracking Is Not Permanence: What Video World Models Keep of a Hidden Object WorldModel

video world models object permanence V-JEPA 2 hidden objects latent prediction

简要说明：本文研究了视频世界模型是否保留隐藏物体的信息，发现像V-JEPA 2这样的预测器会很快丢失被遮挡物体的信息，而编码器保留更多，并且简单的训练可以将物体永久性作为先验安装。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether video world models retain information about hidden objects, finding that predictors like V-JEPA 2 quickly lose track of occluded objects while encoders retain more, and that simple training can install object permanence as a prior.

Abstract: Video world models track objects they can see; we ask what they keep of objects they cannot. We hide an object from a frozen V-JEPA 2 predictor and compare its prediction for the hidden region with the encoder's representation of two worlds that differ only inside that region. The predictor's decision keeps a stationary object in part and one carried inside a container not at all, and loses a moving one within 0.3 s (0.5 s under V-JEPA's own tube mask; ViT-H keeps it to 1.1 s at pretraining's 90% masking ratio); in projection a trace remains, below the midpoint, at 14-60% of what a baseline copying the last view retains. The information is there: the encoder reads the object's presence at 1.00 and keeps a closed container's contents decodable for 3.5 s, while the predictor's output, read with the encoder's own probe, contains the ball in 2% of scenes once the box has been closed for half a second. On rendered scenes, permanence is missing on the predictor's side, and training installs it cheaply as a prior: three thousand predictor-only steps on synthetic containers take this belief from 0.05 to 1.00 against two matched controls. They also raise IntPhys-2019 from 84.2% to 93.3%, but so does a curriculum without containers, and which training habit the benchmark credits changes with its scoring rule. Continued training with tube masks produces 1.1-1.6 s of moving-object carry-over on manipulation and internet-style video, so the deficit is not intrinsic to latent prediction. VideoMAE keeps almost nothing, and Cosmos's next-token prediction keeps a stationary hidden object but not one carried inside a moving container.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型能够追踪它们所见到的物体；我们探究的是，对于那些它们无法看见的物体，它们又能保留多少信息。我们将一个物体从冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器中隐藏起来，并将其对隐藏区域的预测与编码器对两个仅在隐藏区域内部有所不同的世界的表征进行比较。预测器的决策会部分保留静止物体，而对放置在容器内携带的物体则完全不保留，并且在0.3秒内（在V-JEPA自身的管状掩码下为0.5秒；ViT-H在预训练90%掩码率下可将其保留至1.1秒）丢失运动中的物体；在投影中，轨迹残留在中点以下，仅占基线（复制最后视图）所保留信息的14-60%。信息本身是存在的：编码器以1.00的准确率读取物体的存在性，并能将封闭容器内的内容可解码地保留3.5秒，而预测器的输出（使用编码器自身的探针读取）在盒子关闭半秒后，仅有2%的场景包含该球体。在渲染场景中，预测器一侧缺乏物体恒存性，而训练可以廉价地将其作为先验安装：对合成容器进行三千步仅预测器的训练，可将这一信念从0.05提升至1.00，而与两个匹配的对照组形成对比。这种训练还将IntPhys-2019的成绩从84.2%提升至93.3%，但包含容器的课程设置也是如此，而基准测试归功于何种训练习惯则取决于其评分规则。使用管状掩码的持续训练在操作任务和互联网风格视频上产生了1.1-1.6秒的运动物体携带能力，因此该缺陷并非潜在预测所固有的。VideoMAE几乎不保留任何信息，而Cosmos的下一令牌预测能保留静止的隐藏物体，但无法保留在运动容器内携带的物体。
